text:
I reserved a lunch buffet on 23rd, 2026, last Saturday at the harbor court restaurant and came for the lunch buffet at around 12.05 as usual.

The buffet was excellent as usual. The Food was so delicious. Lots of varieties of desserts, especially cakes.  Food arrangements also were excellent. All the staff are so friendly and helpful. Specially restaurant manager, Mr. Sisira Kumara trying to treat and help the guest generously in his strongest possible way.

I noticed that he personally paid his attention on each and every table and directed his staff to give excellent service. 

And I am very happy to highly recommend that, this is one of the best buffets in Colombo.

I Really appreciate the excellent service of the restaurant manager, Mr. Sisira Kumara and other staff.

But,

When I went there, the officer who handled the reservation directed me to a table next to the entrance.  But I specifically requested the corner table.

The officer/staff member handling seating was not friendly and outright neglected my request with no reasonable explanation or alternative offer. Then I said, if so, I need to cancel the reservation, then later she reluctantly sent me to the other table. Then I Felt dismissed and unwelcome, even though I came in with a simple request. 

People come to a buffet to enjoy a relaxed 2-3 hour lunch with their wives/family, not to be shoved into a dark corner just to taste food. A bit of hospitality goes a long way.

I believed that the buffet experience should be about comfort and enjoying time together, not just eating. I believed that they respect basic seating requests and treat guests properly.

but the poor attitude from certain staff members ruined the experience.

When I went there, only a few arrived and all tables were empty. No specific table reservation for guests.

I noticed that, even by the end of the buffet, there were still many empty tables at the location I requested.

 If you don't have to reserve a seat in advance, if empty tables are available, you should be able to sit and eat wherever you want if you pay for the food. Or at least flexible with the simple request.

I noticed that no one reserved any specific place or table, she has arranged it for her convenience to settle bill payments.

It seems inappropriate for her to only look after her own comfort without looking after the comfort of the guest.

It badly affects the clarity of the goodwill of such a great hotel.

management_response.text:
Dear Sanjeewa,

Thank you for your detailed feedback and kind recommendation. We are pleased to know that you enjoyed the lunch buffet, dessert selection, food arrangements, and the attentive service provided by Sisira and our team.

Please accept our sincere apologies that the seating arrangement did not meet your expectations on this occasion. As it was a busy service with several prior seating requests, our team made every effort to assist, and we are sorry if this was not conveyed with the warmth and clarity expected.

Your comments have been noted and will be reviewed with the relevant team to ensure guest requests are handled with greater care, communication, and flexibility wherever possible.

We truly appreciate your constructive feedback and hope to welcome you back for a more seamless dining experience.

Warm regards,
Team Kingsbury

title: Disappointing experience at Ocean
text:
I’ve been a regular at Ocean for years, but my last visit was pretty disappointing. I ordered the “prawn wontons” as an appetizer from their menu, but what I got were prawn spring rolls—three prawns wrapped in spring roll sheets. When I pointed this out, the manager insisted that they were still wontons just because they had prawns in them which is absurd because the difference between a wontons and a spring rolls is pretty obvious and I honestly expect better from a 5-star hotel.

Then, we ordered a rum and coke with just one shot of rum, but they charged us for two. When we asked about it, they insisted two shots were added, which we didn’t really accept.
Also, I noticed they no longer serve complimentary dinner rolls or chocolates, which were always a nice little extra. 
To top it off, I had a similar issue at Churros, their pastry shop, where we got charged for two pastries but only received one.
It’s really sad to see the quality slip like this, and I hope the management takes these concerns seriously.

management_response.text:

We truly value guests who return time and again, and it is with sincere regret that your latest visit did not live up to the standard you rightfully expect from us.

We are sorry to learn about the issues you encountered, beginning with the confusion regarding your appetizer order. You are absolutely correct a prawn wonton and a spring roll are distinctly different preparations, and you should have received exactly what was stated on the menu. The explanation offered to you was neither accurate nor acceptable, and we apologize for the miscommunication.

We also regret the billing concern relating to your beverage order. If a single shot was requested, the charge should have reflected that. We are looking into this matter with our bar and service teams to ensure billing clarity and accurate pouring practices.

In addition, your comments regarding the discontinued complimentary dinner rolls and chocolates have been noted. While operational adjustments may occur from time to time, they should not come at the expense of guest delight. We are currently reviewing these value additions based on your feedback.

Finally, the error you experienced at Churros is unacceptable. You should never be charged incorrectly, and we apologize for the oversight and the inconvenience it caused.

Please rest assured that your concerns have been shared with the culinary, restaurant management, and billing teams for immediate review and corrective action. Constructive feedback such as yours is essential as we strive to uphold the standards you associate with us.

We very much hope to welcome you back soon for the seamless and memorable dining experience you deserve, and we would be honored to personally host you on your next visit.

Warm regards,

Daminda Jayawardena
Director Front Of House
The Kingsbury Colombo

title: Deeply Disappointed – Not the 5-Star Experience We Expected
text:
We spent 2 nights at The Kingsbury Colombo after a long journey from Anuradhapura and were deeply disappointed from the moment we arrived. We had booked 3 rooms, and the initial ones we were assigned were in shockingly poor condition.

The carpets were filthy, the bathrooms unclean (stains on the doors, unflushed toilets, limescale build-up), and one of the beds had hair on it. In another room, we found old, torn towels that clearly should have been replaced long ago. This was nowhere near the standard one would expect from a reputed five-star hotel.

After we complained to reception, we were moved to 2 suites and one premium room. Unfortunately, the suites were located directly under the banquet hall, where a wedding reception was taking place. The music and noise were unbearable, echoing through the rooms until midnight, making it impossible to sleep. To make matters worse, we received an unsolicited wake-up call at 7 a.m., just as we had finally managed to get some rest.

We were later moved again to two new rooms. While the noise from the banquet hall was still audible, it was at least more manageable this time.

On a positive note, the buffet offered a good selection of dishes. However, the cleanliness was again a concern, we came across dirty plates with crusted food and serving spoons with oily, unclean handles.

Another major disappointment was the overall décor of the hotel. The interiors feel outdated and overdone, with a caricature Victorian design that comes across as gaudy rather than elegant. It adds to the sense that the property is in serious need of modernization.

The only redeeming aspect of our stay was Mr. Thasneem, who went above and beyond to assist us and rectify the issues with the rooms. His professionalism and empathy were commendable, if not for him, we would have rated this hotel zero stars.

Overall, The Kingsbury Colombo desperately needs a thorough upgrade and much stricter attention to cleanliness and maintenance. Sadly, it fell far short of our expectations for a five-star experience.

Thank you for your feedback. We sincerely apologise for the issues you experienced during your stay, and we are grateful for your kind words about Thasneem and will ensure your feedback regarding our rooms, facilities, and service is addressed with the relevant teams to prevent such occurrences in the future.

We would greatly appreciate the opportunity to discuss your experience in more detail so we can better understand and resolve your concerns. Please could you contact us directly at tashya.p@hayleysleisure.com or provide your preferred contact details so a member of our management team can reach out to you personally.

We value your feedback and hope to have the chance to restore your confidence in The Kingsbury Colombo.

Team Kingsbury

title: Service
text:
On check in I was pretty much accused of trying to, do what, cheat the hotel out of a breakfast? I quickly made a reservation as plans had. Changed and booked at the  Kingsbury since I had a two day already at the end of the trip. I did it one my phone and in a bumpy taxi ride. I had evidently forgotten to add my wife as a second person on the reservation. Right away I felt like I was being interrogated about the second person when I presented my passports, two of them. Forgetting to put the second person on the reservation, it happens. Management came and by that time I was not too happy. MGR said he would take care of it. I asked to see my upcoming reservation to make sure I had two people and all was well. Desk thought I was trying to get a free breakfast?

Later in the Ocean restaurant we opted for seafood. Picked out a fish and some octopus. Waiter came around with water and never saw him again. Dinner finally arrived and I requested extra lime and more water. I watched the waiters go to the table on our right three times and add water, twice on our left and it was like we were invisible. No one stopped at all to get us water or the limes. I flagged someone down and explained that I requested water and limes. As we were almost finished with our dinner water and limes came. I didn’t then or now understand what went wrong.

Breakfast the next morning, wife ordered a coffee latte with breakfast. After 20 minutes it still did not arrive. When we asked about it they said the machine was broken and that they were making it by hand but should be out soon. At the end of breakfast we left with no coffee being delivered at all and little to no explanation given. Communication failure. All they had to do was say so and we would’ve ordered something else.

The servers were sincere,  I think they were lacking  in training and good supervision. 
Cut my losses and canceled reservation. I had high expectations for this property but maybe set my sights too high?

management_response.text:
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you for your detailed feedback. We’re truly sorry to hear about the inconveniences you experienced during your stay and that your expectations were not met. What you’ve described falls short of the level of service we aim to provide, and your comments have been shared with the relevant teams for immediate attention and improvement. We appreciate your comments and hope you might consider giving us another opportunity to restore your confidence in us.

Warm regards,
Team Kingsbury

Overall the sky bar staff and manager where great and keep my drinks flowing but sadly the stay which is what you really go for was not up to standard so based on this I can only give them 2 stars.

title: Well planned family dinner with a Toddler - Ruined
text:
I booked the dinner buffet for last Sunday dinner. In my first call I informed there will be 5 adults and a 3 year old toddler. Then the operator clearly told me the seating will be 6. (of cause it has to be we do not go to a 5 star hotel and keep our baby in the lap )

I requested a seating near the window since it'll be easy to keep the toddler distracted. I also requested 3x3 seating since our toddler behaves well while seated in between his parents.The operator said in the call that she have put a special note with this info.

I did this booking on Friday. On Saturday the baby's father informed me recently they went to the same buffet and they faced an unpleasant situ. Once they went to the buffet there was no baby chair to the baby and staff said they should have specially requested for the chair - just informing we have toddler is not enough. and they got a baby chair with a little hustle.

Therefore I called again to make sure I mentioned the Baby chair. during that call I again made sure the special note is there and operator reconfirmed me the details.
On Sunday I got two calls to reconfirm the booking from the Hotel(A guy and then a girl after approximately two hours apart). checked if the details are correct with them both time.

Finally when we arrived around 7.00pm. 

voilà.!!

-- A tiny female staff came, checked the booking by name, escorted us to a seating by window seat of 5 seating (No room for the baby)
-- Told her that's not the booking requested - puzzled and annoyed face was shown to us.
-- Then she escorted us to a six seating 3*3 after I explained verbally (the employee not referring to the notes they took via calls) - this time no window seating.
-- I had to tell her that a six seating 3*3 window seating was what requested;

*******
The staff told me I must have not communicated properly. I told her I did and also reconfirmed in the following calls. shook her head dismissing my claim. I requested her to refer the special note in the booking. she said she checked and there wasn't anything like that. Said
I MUST NOT HAVE TOLD THEM IN WHEN MAKING THE BOOKING..!!!

At this point I was loosing my temper and I told her my calls are getting recorded and invited her to listen to them and show me in their booking system that there is no such information recorded as she's claiming (lying literally) - that was the point she gave up and escorted us to one of the three 3*3 six person window seating arrangements - vacant in the premises when this drama was unfolding. - with a with sour face.

 The baby chair arrived after reminding two three times.. :)

We had to wave like refugees for water refills since waiting staff just pass by without noticing when we wave.

The Cherry on top of the cake was one the staff who involved in the seating drama asking me if I enjoy their "service".

I wonder if these employees are bribed by rival hotels like cinnamon lakeside/ life COD cuz we were all regretting not going there spending little extra and receive better service and food spread.

I've been to this place since it was Ceylon Continental, After rebranding to Kingsbury, to High tea, brunch, bar, Honey Beach many times and had a lot of pleasant memories here. but will never choose this place unless I'm a guest of someone else who chose this place.

I'm questioning the management on:

- Why your staff not attending the booking requirements made while making the appointment.???
- Why don't they read the special notes in the bookings?
- Why they are not asking the golden question if the guests need a baby chair for the baby when they mention there is a baby among the guests?? if they have a policy of only providing it on prior request?
- Why your Sunday international dinner buffet don't have the must have staples like lamb, blue cheese. the cashew curry in Sri Lankan cuisine?

This will be the end of my visits to once glorious Kingsbury...!!

Never again..!!

Food and drinks 
Poor spread for the standard of 5 star international Sunday Dinner Buffet - No lamb, Blue Cheese - cashew curry in Sri Lankan corner. Sushi Spread poor. No checkers verity. only pumpkin and pecans as nuts. Staff not asking what temperature water the guest want - just pours the water.

Noteworthy details
Staff full of blunders - almost ruined our outing - we only had a good time because we decided to shake off the unpleasantness. - Not at all the 5 star service.

Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. We sincerely apologise for the inconvenience and the frustration caused during your recent visit, especially regarding the seating arrangements and baby chair. Your experience clearly did not meet the high standards we aim to provide, and we regret the impact it had on your family dinner.

When we returned, security staff led by Pushpakumara demanded an unreasonable parking fee. First, they quoted Rs. 7,500/-, then Rs. 5,000/-, and finally Rs. 3,000/- for just 1.5 hours. title: One of the Worst Experiences – Completely Let Down by Kingsbury Colombo
text:
I’m writing this with genuine disappointment after what should have been a joyful family celebration turned into a frustrating and upsetting experience at Kingsbury Colombo. I took my family out for lunch to celebrate my brother’s wedding, expecting excellence based on Kingsbury’s name and reputation. Sadly, what we received was the complete opposite.

We paid LKR 4,700 per person for six people—this was not a casual meal or a discounted offer. It was a special treat for a once-in-a-lifetime occasion. I trusted Kingsbury to deliver a premium experience. Instead, we were met with poor service, disorganized staff, and unprofessional behavior.

From the moment we walked in, the experience was uncomfortable. The staff member at the restaurant entrance, Achini, greeted us with zero warmth or professionalism. Her attitude was dismissive and rude—definitely not what you’d expect from someone in a customer-facing role at a 5-star hotel. She clearly lacks the basic understanding of hospitality and customer care.

To make things worse, when I made the booking, I was specifically told that the hotel would provide a complimentary cake for the newlyweds. Even after more than two hours, no one mentioned it. I had to ask, and once again Achini responded with an unacceptable attitude—like it was an inconvenience for her. She didn’t even apologize for forgetting something that was part of the promise.

I’ve dined in many hotels across Sri Lanka—some even rated 2 or 3 stars—and received far better service than this. The Kingsbury name carries weight, and I truly believed they would make this family moment special. Instead, I felt embarrassed and disappointed in front of my family for choosing this place.

This is not just about bad service—it’s about failing a guest on a special day. Management seriously needs to retrain staff like Achini and review their internal standards, because if this is how guests are treated, it will only damage the hotel’s long-standing reputation.

I will not be returning to Kingsbury, and I cannot recommend it to anyone expecting professionalism, warmth, or value for money.

Thank you for sharing your feedback with us. We are truly sorry to learn that your special family celebration did not meet expectations. Please accept our sincere apologies for the lapses in service and attentiveness you experienced. title: Feedback on My Recent Stay at Kingsbury Hotel, Sri Lanka
text:
Dear [Hotel Management/Customer Service Team],

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to formally express my dissatisfaction regarding my recent stay at Kingsbury Hotel, Sri Lanka, from June 11 to June 16, 2025. While I had high expectations based on the hotel's reputation, my experience fell short in several key areas.

Check-In Experience: Upon arrival, the check-in process was relatively smooth; however, I was disappointed to find that the hotel could not accommodate the specific room I had originally opted for. This was my first indication that my stay might not meet my expectations.

Laundry Service Discrepancy: The most significant issue arose during my checkout. I had received a confirmed email outlining the room tariff, which included 4 pieces of laundry per day. Given my 5-night stay, I was entitled to a total of 20 pieces of laundry. Unfortunately, I did not utilize the laundry service during the first three days of my stay. However, on the 4th and 5th days, I submitted 13 pieces and 7 pieces of laundry, respectively.

At checkout, the billing staff initially requested payment for all 20 pieces of laundry. Subsequently, I was informed that I was only eligible for 8 pieces, as the hotel staff claimed that my lack of usage during the first three days limited my entitlement. Despite my attempts to clarify the situation and present the confirmed inclusion in my tariff, the staff remained unyielding and dismissive. As a result, I was compelled to pay for 12 pieces of laundry, amounting to LKR 5139.00, in addition to an extra USD 45 for the inclusion of the laundry service.

Staff Conduct: I must also address the demeanor of the front office staff during this encounter. Their attitude was not only unwelcoming but also hostile, which exacerbated an already frustrating situation. This lack of professionalism is concerning, especially for a hotel of your standing, and it detracts from the overall guest experience.

Conclusion: While Kingsbury Hotel is well-regarded among both local and international guests, my experience has raised concerns about the rigidity of staff policies and the overall guest service. I believe that addressing these issues is crucial not only for the hotel's reputation but also for the positive image of Sri Lanka as a travel destination.

I hope that my feedback will be taken into consideration to improve future guest experiences. Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Sincerely,

Kaustav Das

Thank you so much for taking the time to share your feedback with us following your recent stay at The Kingsbury, Colombo. We are truly sorry to hear that your experience did not meet the high standards we strive to uphold and that your visit left you feeling disappointed.

We sincerely apologise for the inconvenience regarding your room allocation and the confusion surrounding the laundry service. We completely understand how frustrating this must have been, especially at checkout, and regret that it affected your overall impression of your stay. Please rest assured that your concerns have been shared with our senior management and the relevant teams for a thorough review and immediate action.

We are also very sorry to hear about your interaction with our front office team. This is not reflective of the genuine hospitality and professional service we aim to offer all our guests, and your feedback is being taken very seriously.

To ensure your concerns are personally addressed, a member of our team will be reaching out to you shortly. In the meantime, if there is anything more you would like to share or if we can be of any further assistance, please feel free to contact us at crm@thekingsburyhotel.com. We would truly appreciate the opportunity to make things right and hope to welcome you back for a far more enjoyable experience in the future.

Warmest regards,
The Kingsbury, Colombo team

title: A Huge Dissapointment about this Kingsbury
text:
Kingsbury is a huge disappointment!!
First of all, when we came by our car, there was no doorman to open the hotel doors or even the back doors of the car. I went there in the third week of March for my best friend's birthday. We were 4 friends in total, and it was our treat for the birthday boy. To my surprise, there was no staff to ask about where Harbour Court was, since it was our first time visiting The Kingsbury. Our first choice was our usual hotel which is a luxury 5-star hotel in Colombo; I prefer not to say their name on here and it is a top ranked hotel on this platform. Yet there were no proper staff or the ones available were very busy with foreign guests. I think they have no interest in serving local Sri Lankan people, where we felt very discriminated against. After asking a person seated on the lobby chairs, who I think was a guest too, we finally found out. We went to Harbour Court. Again, they disappointed me. I made a reservation around 2 pm by calling the hotel for the dinner buffet and asked to reserve a table with a view, that means a 4-pax table near the big glass window. They told me they would surely reserve the relevant table near the window. But the girl at the restaurant reception reserved a table far away from the window and very near to the buffet, where people were busy picking food. It made us very stressed because it was crowded, and we couldn’t even have a little private conversation because people in the food queue could hear us.
OK, that is bearable, we can forgive it. But I was very amazed to see that in this kind of luxury fine dining, there are no waiters. For the whole crowded restaurant, I could find only 3 or 4 managers wearing coats who had no interest in serving guest's requirements, they were just talking and laughing with each other. I saw only one waiter in a waiter suit. We wanted cool water for our glasses after coming to the table with the food. We wanted to say this to a waiter, but there was only one waiter, and I saw maybe three people with ties and white shirts serving others, but they were busy serving the other half of the restaurant. We were wondering, where are these people who are working? These are not fake stories, and I too couldn't believe that we had to face these awful things in this kind of a luxury hotel.

Then, finally, after a few minutes of looking for anyone, a manager came. I can’t remember his name, but he was a bit bald-headed. After asking, he went to bring cold water. Then again, they failed to meet our requirement. They brought OLU water instead of normal filtered water with ice. I think the bottle costs 400 rupees, but with tax and everything, it should be around 600, I guess. The manager brought three OLU water bottles instead of what we asked; normal filtered water with ice. Is there any intention to cost guests more by making profits cunningly? We had to use these OLU bottles because if we reject them, we would have waited another half an hour looking for a waiter to bring us water. I want to mention that one of the managers came and offered us the drinks menu. One of my friends politely said we’ll order later in the eating session because we wanted to. Shockingly, this guy came again and again, insisting that we order some cocktails by being a big headache. He kept recommending different kinds of drinks, disturbing our conversations. Since it was my friend's birthday, I went to the reception girl and requested to sing happy birthday to my friend. I want to mention that on the occasion, there were other people having birthdays and two girls and one boy were singing happy birthday to them. It was unusual they were busy doing that. Somehow, even after two requests, they forgot to wish my friend. It would have made his day!!! After two requests, I stopped asking them to sing and I dropped that idea, thinking never ever coming to this hotel again, and I will not recommend it to anyone. 

I want to strictly ask that, don't you guys care about your guests??? The reason I say that is because including myself, we are big fans of egg hoppers. The action station was queued with a lot of people willing to get hoppers. I think they should put two or more chefs to do that.

After all these things, the main part of the buffet is food, right? I thought we would forget all these shocking disappointments after eating good soothing food with some mouth-watering seafood. But I don’t know the reason, shockingly, we were so unfortunate because the food was extremely disappointing. Steamed rice and biriyani were the only rice options. Not even fried rice was there. Is Kingsbury an Indian hotel like Taj Samudra??? Because 60% of the food was Indian food! The beef was very chewy and not even slightly tender, resulting in me giving back my plate with that low quality beef. My friends strongly recommended that Kingsbury dinner buffet has more seafood varieties than other hotels, but being a seafood lover, I could barely find any seafood. I was wondering where this so-called legacy of Kingsbury has gone. So disappointing! The only seafood was some butter-fried pieces. Thinking something is better than nothing, I ate them. Again, as usual, it was disappointing. They had a very thin small fillet of fish under a big butter-fried layer. 
To be more specific, there was only chewy low-quality cuttlefish and fish with big layers of butter and oil. I mean, what is this guys? How can you make people feel mislead and take huge amounts of money for these low-quality food collections while claiming a very high standard five-star hotel? Then we came to the dessert section. Being a big ice-cream lover, I straightly went to the ice-cream kottu action station. To my huge disappointment, the guy in the dessert section said very rudely, "There's no ice cream kottu, and we can't provide it since the board of the ice cream kottu maker is broken and not freezing to be eligible to make ice cream kottu." Guys, this reflects a lack of attention to basic hospitality standards.  Can’t you guys try to repair it as soon as possible and provide the specific dessert again? Instead of being rude to guests. Then I tried to get normal ice cream, but the same rude guy serving ice cream was pouring scoops as little as laddus. Only two little scoops. It was disappointing to see such limited portions being served, especially for a high end buffet. Then the small chocolate pieces were finished, and only dark chocolate and mint chocolate was left, and they were not restocking for people. It’s very sad to see two tables away from us getting a birthday singing with a small cake but not us.

So, thank you very much Kingsbury for showing your true colors!! I am not coming to Kingsbury again and will not recommend it to others. These positive reviews about this Kingsbury are also very false because after paying the bill this manager guy came and asked from the four of us to write a good review with 5 stars mentioning his name. I felt very sad about these guys begging for good reviews on this platform. Finally, to whoever reading this, I wanna say I strongly advise others to reconsider before visiting Kingsbury!

text:

Yesterday, we came for my best friend’s bride to be party just six of us. We made a reservation at Honey Beach Club for six people. When we made the reservation, we clearly asked what would happen if it rained. They assured us that if it rained, they would arrange seating in an indoor area.

They were shouting without any discipline and rudely asked me to move. It was very uncomfortable. Is that what hospitality looks like in a star-class hotel? We felt like we were in a street restaurant.

After that, we returned to our table. When my other friends arrived with a cake, no one provided a knife or a side plate until we asked for it. We did not expect such poor service from a hotel of this standard.

Then, it started to rain, and we wanted to place an order, but no staff members were available. We waited, and as the rain got heavier, no one took responsibility for the guests. Eventually, we moved inside, and at least the F&B staff acknowledged us, but where were the managers? I saw one person in a full suit, but he didn’t even smile at the guests.

To make matters worse, all our drinks got caught in the rain, and instead of replacing them immediately, they brought the drinks  now mixed with rainwater back to our table. Can anyone drink that? We had to ask for new drinks, and only then did they provide them.

However, I want to appreciate one lady who helped us dry our clothes .her service was commendable.

I’m also a hotelier, which is why we chose this venue for such a special occasion, but it turned out to be the worst experience we’ve had at a star-class hotel. There were so many staff members in full suits perhaps managers but what’s the point of having them if they don’t lead their team or step in when guests are facing issues?

Why should we spend our money on this kind of service ?

text:
We visited for one night as the last hotel of our tour of Sri Lanka.

The rooms were OK. Clean and nicely appointed but the little details let it down. Badly painted ceilings (going over fittings), old carpet, lights in the wardrobe not working, no minibar or complimentary water.

Service in the buffet restaurant, Harbour, was equally poor. It was self service buffet but ordering and receiving a drink took over 20 minutes from sitting down. 

The Sky lounge was the only exception. We got excellent service in this bar and the selection of drinks was good as well (no draught beer though).

This certainly isn't one of the worst hotels but it was the worst one compared to all of the other hotels we stayed at in our 2 week tour.

As a frequent visitor to this hotel every two years, I expected better communication, especially since the concierge team has previously been very reliable, even during peak seasons. If they were unable to arrange the booking, a simple response acknowledging my request would have been appreciated. A hotel's reputation is built on consistency, and such lapses can leave even loyal guests questioning their future stays. VERRY DISSAPOINTED! title: Extreme NOISE from pool every night
text:
It promised so much but we were so let down. Check in took ages but we were upgraded. However things went downhill from there. The extreme  noise from the pool area starts around 430pm & doesn’t abate until 11pm nightly. The hotel is very upmarket in all other areas. For example, in the lobby area they have someone playing on the piano which is quite nice. The noise from the pool is unacceptable. Room windows are not glazed & even on level 8 the noise was incredibly loud. Not only that we were treated quite poorly by the staff. Someone knocked on our door to do a “room check“ when we had slept in but in fact we felt like they were checking on us. I purchased two glasses of champagne to take to the room, I signed for them and then was yelled at in the lobby by one of the staff from the bar telling me that I had to pay cash as it could not be posted to the room, even though I had signed for the drinks, I complained to the manager who sent to cupcakes to the room (!), but then the same thing happened only hours later when my husband’s very late laundry arrived in the room at 8pm as we were walking out and we were asked to pay cash as again it “could not be posted” to the room. We complained to the night manager but it’s simply not good enough. This never happens to us in any other hotel and we do travel extensively around the world. We provided our credit card at check-in. When we complained we were then told that the dry cleaning and the bars were all run separately.  So what? Also, the food & drinks are extremely overpriced ie Australian Oyster Bay worth AUD$17 is a whopping AUD$95 in their restaurants! I also got bitten by a bug that was in the pool which is in desperate need of repair, although fairly clean. There’s only about 10 deck chairs in the pool area, not enough for the amount of guests in the hotel
Beds were comfortable, the room was adequate and clean but the blinds didn’t close up so there’s a lot of light coming in to the room.

management_response.text:
Dear Annette790,

Thank you for your detailed feedback. We sincerely apologize for the shortcomings you experienced during your stay. Your concerns about noise, service, and pricing have been noted, and we will address these with the relevant teams to ensure improvements. We regret the inconvenience caused and appreciate you sharing your observations, as they help us enhance our guests' experience.

Warm regards,
The Kingsbury, Colombo team

title: Nightmare Christmas Buffet at The Kingsbury
text: Christmas lunch at one of the big hotels in Colombo is magical. But not when its The Kingsbury. Having booked & paid for a table weeks in advance for 10 at $35 per head and being told we could bring our own alcohol for a corkage fee & choose where we sat, we arrived with guests & booze on Christmas day, & told our table was not available. We were squashed into a a back table with no glasses or cutlery & a floor covered in food scraps sticking to our shoes. No waiters came to set the table so we drank wine in water glasses. They changed the offer on Christmas day & said no corkage was offered. At the end of the meal on a dirty table, they charged us again for the $350 buffet we had already paid. They said they hadnt received the payment & accounts was closed so couldn't check payment, as though it was our fault. We showed bank statements showing payment to The Kingsbury. Then they said their system was down. After 1 hrs wait they corrected the issue. A greedy & terrible experience. Cinnamon Grand & Shangri-la buffet is far superior and worth the money.

management_response.text:
Dear twitchywitch,

Thank you for sharing your detailed feedback. We deeply regret the issues you faced during your Christmas lunch and apologize for the inconvenience caused. This is not the experience we strive to provide, and we will thoroughly review your concerns with our team to ensure such incidents are not repeated.

Warm regards,
The Kingsbury, Colombo team

title: TERRIBLE experience - 2 hours to check-in, room smelled of smoke, incredibly noisy
text:
> It took 2 hours to check-in (the room wasn’t ready.
> When we arrived at the room, it still wasn’t ready. They were moving furniture into the room. 
> The non-smoking room smelled like smoke. 
> The rooftop “Sky Lounge” was closed for a private event. 
> It took over 20 minutes for someone to take our order at the pool-side lounge. 
> It took another 20 minutes for our drink, which the waiter spilled on the way to our table. 
> After waiting 20 minutes  trying to get our bill, just walked to the manager at the bar and paid cash so we could leave.

If they were really sorry, they would have offered to reduce the bill.

title: Not a place to stay
text:
Not a place to stay. The staff are all excellent and friendly, but the venue is a wedding event space. Great if you're getting married, but not if you are booking a room.
I could have forgiven the fact they couldn't send an engineer to fix the tv and they did a great job finding me another room where I tv worked (eventually), but the booming music from the roof top bar is a nightmare. To top that off, getting woken (twice) by room service knocking at my door before 8am and just after, to tell me I was checking out (at 12:00pm) was the end of my patience.
Forget it. Not worth it....unless you're getting married!

Upon further investigation, we found that the TV in Room #427 was fully functional and the issue was related to the operating procedure. We regret any confusion this may have caused.

Lastly, we truly apologize for the early room service visits. This was not in line with our usual standards, and we have already addressed this internally to ensure it does not happen again.

We greatly appreciate your feedback and will continue working to improve our services. We hope you will consider giving us another opportunity to provide you with a more enjoyable stay in the future.

The Kingsbury, Colombo Team

title: Nightclub not Sleep
text:
The staff is friendly and helpful upon arrival and departure, appearing very officious and upscale.  However, the entire experience was tanked by the nightclub they seem to prioritize out at the pool.  Based on the postings in the elevator, it runs until midnight.  I had a 4:30 am flight and was trying to get some sleep prior to leaving the hotel at 12:00 am.  No such luck.  I was on the 4th floor above the pool, and up until I left it sounded like I had a DJ at the foot of my bed.  It was SO loud.  I was not alone in my complaints - the rest of my group hated the experience as well.  

Recommendation to management: pick a lane - upscale travelers retreat or downmarket nightclub.  If you can't decide, go for a third option - turn down the music and shut it off earlier.  I would recommend management try and sleep with it as it is now to really understand the experience you are offering your guests.

management_response.text:
Dear Kat9699,

title: Would benefit from some improvements
text:
We arrived at the hotel lobby to a scene of chaos. Hordes of people, some trying to check-in, others guests from various functions and staff completely out of their depth. Felt like a railway station. We were a group of 6 and our passports were taken. We then just waited for over 20 minutes with no one telling us what was going on. Finally, when we complained, there was some excuse given about rooms. The chaos in the reception area continued all day and we were told there were 3 weddings and a corporate event being held, all at the same time! It did get better the next day. 

Our “pool view” room actually overlooked a car park, but if we squeezed into a corner near the window we could catch a glimpse of the pool! Our room had a cupboard door saying mini bar but there wasn’t even a fridge behind it. There appeared to have been a shortage of hand towels as all our group only received one between two people.

On the plus side, the breakfast was excellent. The room service staff were pleasant as were those at the reception desk. We had an early start and were provided with a good packed breakfast .

This a 5 star hotel and should ensure a calm atmosphere when guests are checking in or using the lobby area. There should be a separate entrance for private function attendees.

Thank you for your feedback. We sincerely apologize for the challenges you experienced during check-in and the issues with your room. We appreciate your positive remarks about our breakfast and room service staff. Your comments are valuable as we strive to improve our guest experience, and we hope to welcome you back for a more enjoyable stay in the future.

The Kingsbury, Colombo team

title: Dangerous official hotel website.
text:
The Kingsbury Hotel official website directed my bookings to a 3rd party booking. I found out upon checking out because the hotel was unable to provide me with an invoice. During booking, it was impossible to know. In other words there is serious security breached. If I wanted to book through a 3 party booking site, I would have done so through Booking.com or other 3rd party website. Hotel staffs were unhelpful. All said was I booked through a 3rd party. When I went through the steps  with the front desk staffs on how booking was done at The Kingsbury Hotel website, the front desk kept quiet. Now I am left with out an invoice to make any official business claims.
To make matter worst, the language and tone of the staffs at the front office was in the direction of it's was your own doing and your own fault
One of the staff even had the cheek to say I should be happy I had a good room to stay in. I rebuked him and told him it was a basic requirement of the hotel to provide good room.
This hotel may look very grand on the exterior, the room inside was old and dated. Carpet was dirty, it had lots of stains. One can tell the carpet had not been changed since it was taken over by local owner.
Food wise wasn't fantastic. Steak was over done when i requested for medium. Salmon fish was overcooked and oily at the Japan restaurant located at the highest level.
I do not recommend anyone stay in this hotel. Not value for money. Service was bad and most importantly, there is a breach in their website. PLEASE BE CAREFUL.

title: Hit and miss experience at the icon of Colombo !
text:
I recently stayed at this beautiful and luxurious hotel that everyone raves about in the city and I definitely wanted to check it out myself. I travelled from Galle and pampered myself to a two night stay at The Kingsbury. 

The hotel is grand and very welcoming to smiling faces of staff working there and showering their warm hospitality upon everyone. The hotel was busy which was great for the business and team were on their toes to ensure a great experience for everyone staying or visiting. 
 
Coming to the positives - 

1. Food was outstanding everywhere. Tried 4-5 outlets throughout the stay and the food and hospitality at the F&B outlets was divine specially at Yue Chuan and Tenku. The F&B team was great and chefs really definitely did put their heart and soul into the cooking.

2. Spa at the hotel was amazing. Really professional therapists and the team at the reception was truly welcoming and ensured a great experience during the therapies. I did have a suggestion and have already mentioned it to the spa team and that is to keep some loofahs at the spa on request for those guests to do choose to take a shower there itself. 

3. Gymnasium was well equipped and definitely maintained to a great standard.

Unfortunately there were a few hiccups as well. 

1. First and foremost , I was actually given a key to an occupied room on arrival. The guest occupying the room was lady and she was getting her makeup done when I walked in assuming she must be at the hotel for an event. However it was very embarrassing for both of us as she was in the middle of getting ready and I just invaded her privacy unknowingly. I definitely apologised for the inconvenience and went back to the reception and did let the team know. They mentioned that due to Houskeeping’s negligence, the room was marked ready as per their system. I hope they did speak to the guest and made sure everything was fine ! It was surely a very big inconvenience to the guest occupying the room and myself ! Unfortunately nothing was done post that by the team with regard to the same. 

2. I had placed my order for lunch through room service upon arrival in the new room  however the team member who delivered the food requested for the payment to be done at the same time rather than posting it to the room. It was actually the case for all the outlets I visited and none of them billed the checks to the room. Unfortunately not all the in-house guests like to carry their credit cards along to every space of the hotel they visit. Looked quite odd but that might just be the hotel policy unfortunately it was not informed upon arrival. 

3. I had placed an order through the beach club for lunch on the day of departure which took about an hour and a half to be delivered to the room. I had reconfirmed with the employee at the beach club about the delivery and he over excitedly mentioned to have it served without an issue within 20-25 minutes. However after two follow-ups once through the reception and second through the room service, the order was finally served.

There were a few ups and downs about The Kingsbury however overall what I had heard off about the service and hospitality unfortunately that little spark was missing which could have definitely elevated the entire stay experience i was hoping for !

title: Staff pimping hookers to guests, noisy, no WiFi, no customer care - AVOID AT ALL COST
text:
I was due to stay at The Kingsbury on business for seven nights, instead I checked out after four and went elsewhere.  A shocking experience.

I’m not really sure where to start, but I will save the worst issue until last.

Perhaps the most startling aspect was the well dressed lobby staff pimpimg out prostiutes to guests.  I still can’t believe how brazen they were doing this, but having looked back at earlier reviews on this site, The Kingsbury has ‘previous’ at pushing hookers onto guests.  There must be a kickback to staff involved I imagine.

I was staying at The Kingsbury on business, and needed a decent hotel WiFi for VC and telephone calls.  The number of VC’s with clients that were disconnected due to WiFi blowing hot and cold was very disappointing.   I tried two different bedrooms but with the same result.   In the end I had to take calls in communal areas where the WiFi was better, but this isn’t ideal when trying to discuss sensitive matters with colleagues and clients.

Regardless of what room you are in (I was in a room on the other side of the hotel to the pool), don’t expect to sleep before 11.00pm / 11.30pm.  As reported on this site by previous guests, the live band’s music from the swimming pool bar is deafening.  The decibels are also in competition with the music from another hotel across the road (The Steuard maybe?).  Sleeping at midnight and waking up for a 7.30am breakfast meeting is annoying one time, every time is infuriating. 

I decided to have a 90 min sports massage in the Kingsbury’s spa.  On arrival I asked the receptionist if she wanted me to pay there and then, but she said I should pay after the massage.  I went to the room, changed into the loin cloth that was provided, and began to relax as the massage started.  Then there was a knock at the door.  The spa wanted me to get dressed, go to reception and pay, before then returning to the  massage room, changing back into the loin cloth, and relaxing again.  I just got dressed and left.

The worst issue for me (and in only four days there were a fair few), began at midnight.  Having just drifted to sleep as the hotel became quieter, I was woken by hammering on my ceiling.  I was in one of the 9th floor executive rooms, and above it is a function room.   As there was a wedding the next day, The Kingsbury decided that midnight was the most appropriate time for ten workers to lay a new floor and build a set for the wedding.  The noise was incredible.  They refused  to stop building, saying that it didn’t matter if I had paid for a quiet room.  I was trumped by the revenue that they were getting for the wedding function, and they already had my money.  They simply didn’t care..  At 1am I was offered a room on a different floor, but I refused and told them that I was checking out.   Thankfully the nearby Hilton found me a room, they really were excellent and I’m very grateful to them.  A small saving grace was the The Kingsbury eventually agreed how rubbish they were, and paid for my stay at The Hilton.

Having travelled the world with work, The Kingsbury is honestly the worst hotel that I’ve ever stayed in.  The place is dated, they care more for an extra revenue they can make (pool bar, weddings, hookers) than they do for the guests who have already given them their money.

title: Strategically located between economy and luxury of Colombo
text:
We recently stayed in this hotel in a short getaway from our busy lives.

The hotel enjoys a prime location, situated amidst luxury and budget shopping districts. A short 15-20 minute walk in either direction leads guests to either the vibrant Pettah market offering economic shopping or the upscale One Galle Face Mall. Despite its central location, the hotel itself maintains a peaceful ambience. Upper floors offer particularly serene views, making them ideal for relaxation. 

The panoramic vista from the upper floors, especially during the evening and night, creates a calming atmosphere. Guests can enjoy a tranquil experience overlooking the illuminated cityscape of the newly constructed port city. While the weather can be hot, the hotel benefits from cool sea breezes, mitigating the surrounding temperature considerably.

The hotel offers a variety of guest amenities, including multiple restaurants, a swimming pool, an executive lounge, and various other general amenities. The property stands out for its well-maintained and clean condition, exceeding expectations compared to many other hotels. Despite its age and past challenges, the hotel demonstrates exceptional care in upkeep, minimizing visible wear and tear.

It is important to acknowledge that while the hotel excelled in several aspects, there is significant room for improvement in the quality of service offered by the staff. Unfortunately, our experience suggests that a majority of staff members displayed a level of neglect and carelessness that detracted from the overall stay. This lack of attentiveness was consistently observed across various touchpoints, including vehicle parking, restaurants, and room service. This resulted in a feeling of being unwelcome within the establishment, regardless of the reason behind the perceived inattentiveness. It is crucial to emphasize that as paying guests, all individuals deserve a warm and welcoming experience regardless of their nationality (since we noticed many foreign nationals residing in this establishment). Addressing the service concerns and ensuring consistent attentiveness towards all guests will be crucial in encouraging repeat visits.

Additionally the Wi-Fi was very slow during most of the hours including non peak hours like 4 am.

Overall, I this regardless of the issues in the service provided, I think this is a good hotel for a short getaway or a business stay considering the location of the hotel

title: Fine if you like corporate hotels with dodgy service & too much noise
text:
The Kingsbury presents itself as a high quality 'top end' hotel. It certainly has a wide range of facilities and the room was comfortable for a short stay. However, the quality of service and levels of noise mean that it misses the mark when compared with other hotels of its type around the globe. 

We stayed 1 night ahead of an early start for a flight home. The greeting by reception staff was seemingly good. However, we asked specifically for a packed breakfast the following day at 6am as we were leaving early for the airport. We were told this would be arranged as breakfast was included in our room rate.

Unfortunately it was not delivered to the room and was not available at reception at checkout at 6am. The receptionist seemed to doubt our word and instead of looking to organise something quickly for us wasted time asking me to either name, or describe, the person to whom we spoke on check-in. There was no attempt to apologise and no recognition of the fact that our driver was waiting to take us to the airport. Poor. 

Room service food was of good quality and delivered quickly. However, the person delivering the food insisted that we pay for it at the time of delivery, instead of it being added to our room bill. He suggested he could take our credit card away with him to process the payment - a classic 'card cloning' trick. On refusing this he went away and came back later with a card machine. This despite the fact we had offered a card at the reception desk earlier. 

These service issues let the aimed for quality of the hotel down. As does the fact that there is VERY loud music played in the poolside bar area until after 10.30pm at night. Not terribly helpful to those wanting good sleep before an early flight. 

The Kingsbury is a perfectly comfortable hotel for those who don't mind evening noise and want a wide range of restaurants and facilities without stepping outside into Colombo. However, in terms of service it was he worst experience we encountered in a 4 week Sri Lankan stay using 10 other hotels around the country. More attention to detail beyond the 'corporate' smiling greetings is required.

Dear N17420JTmatthews,

title: Doesn't live up to five-star rating
text:
NOISE: The loud noise was our biggest issue. We are staying on the seventh floor, and yet can still very clearly hear the loud music from the Honey Beach club from 6pm until midnight as if we were right there on the ground! Even with noise cancelling AirPods, I can still hear the music from my room. They did not warn us about this problem upon check-in, even though we were coming in as a family with young kids. This is the opposite of five-star elegance.

If you are coming here for a restful and relaxing stay, like what we expected, the Kingsbury is not for you. To the Kingsbury--you must figure out a way to deal with this noise problem for all the rooms overlooking the beach club as it is disturbing and honestly extremely disrespectful for those trying to work or relax. Many other reviews from the past several years have pointed out this problem and you have yet to fix it. 

ROOMS: For a five-star hotel, the rooms were a lot smaller than one would expect. Other four- and five-star properties we stayed at in Colombo have much nicer rooms than what we found here. They are showing signs of age and are very dimly lit even with all lights on. If you are looking for a scenic view, you won't find one here--not the hotel's fault, but due to the Port City development all you see is a building site with barely even a peek of ocean. The internet is also extremely slow and spotty.

SERVICE: The service was probably the only highlight of this experience: everyone was very helpful and attentive. Our check-in experience was marred with some issues from the booking site, but staff was very helpful in assisting us with the problem. Servers at the beach club and roti restaurant were wonderful--shout-out to the live performers at the roti hut who we could barely hear over the beach club's annoying music but appreciated anyway. The one pitfall with service we experiences was that despite a seemingly endless plethora of staff, it took an hour of waiting plus going down to remind staff to bring our bags up to the room after check-in. 

Overall, not the five-star experience we hoped for.

title: To be avoided. Not good for vegetarians
text:
We stayed here for 2 nights in late June. 

Where to start. 

The rooms are very old and run down. They are also tiny. There is minimal separation for privacy when using the bathroom given the abysmal size and layout.

Dining is also terrible for vegetarians at night. 

Morning buffet gives quite a few good vegetarian options but there are very few places to eat at night that cater appropriately to vegetarians.

The nightly buffet is expensive and whilst there is an abundance of mediocre meat dishes and two or three seafood options, vegetarian options are simply:

1) Some poorly prepared pasta concoction
2) dhal
3) the same small vegetable side dishes the meat eaters get
4) poorly prepared western or french style potatoes.

There is never any soya meat or veg meat prepared interestingly. There are never vegetable skewers. There is never paneer (including paneer Tika masala which is unforgivable). There are never interesting vegetarian gravy curries like eggplant gravy curry, aloo gobi gravy style.

In this regard, the Indian hotels do it far, far better and even the western hotels are far beyond places like the Kingsbury. 

On one night, we made the mistake of having an egg kothu at the outside bar and a beer. It cost nearly $35 USD each. This is a joke. The quality was a 3/10.

This place is more name and style than substance. Stay at the Hilton or the G next door.

Regretting having picked Kingsbury.

title: Food poisoning for 6-7 people and still no proper actions taken!
text:
We recently had a highly disappointing experience at the supposedly luxurious Kingsbury Honeybeach Hotel. This incident occurred during a client get-together, which was supposed to be a memorable and enjoyable event. However, what unfolded instead was a distressing case of food poisoning that resulted in several individuals falling ill, requiring medical attention, and one person even being admitted to the hospital.

The timeline of events reveals a series of concerning and inadequate responses from the hotel management. On June 7th, our group visited the hotel, eagerly anticipating a pleasant stay. Unfortunately, the following day, on June 8th, some of us began experiencing symptoms of food poisoning. We immediately made individual complaints about the matter. 1 of the members was admitted to the hospital for 23 hours in Durdance hospital (attached in photos), and 3 more members had to visit OPD or hospitals for medication. 3-4 other members had symptoms such as diarrhea. 

Since there was no proper response for individual complaints made on 8th June, our company made an official complaint to their Manager Mr. Mark on 10th June (see attachments for email thread)

On June 13th, we finally received a reply from the hotel, but it was disheartening to see that it merely stated they would "look into the matter." This generic response did not address our specific grievances and failed to provide any reassurance or explanation regarding the food poisoning incident.

Following that, on June 15th, we received an official reply from the hotel, which was deeply disappointing. Instead of acknowledging the severity of the situation and taking responsibility, they completely ignored our accusations. It is important to note that our claims were supported by medical reports, screenshots, and the bills for the medical treatment we received as a result of their negligence.

Expressing our dissatisfaction and concern, the company reiterated on June 16th that this incident was not an isolated case of food intolerance but a clear food poisoning event. It is shocking that despite the growing number of affected individuals—around six to seven people—Kingsbury Honeybeach Hotel has failed to address our concerns or take any meaningful action to rectify the situation.

Today, as I write this review on June 21st, we are still waiting for a response from the hotel. Their persistent silence and lack of consideration for our well-being are utterly disheartening. It is evident that they have disregarded our health and safety, as well as the trust we placed in them as guests.

I strongly advise potential visitors to exercise caution before choosing to stay at Kingsbury Honeybeach Hotel. The hotel's failure to respond promptly and appropriately to a food poisoning incident, coupled with its disregard for the well-being of their guests, raises serious concerns about their commitment to customer satisfaction and their responsibility as a five-star establishment.

It is my hope that this review serves as a warning to others and encourages the management of Kingsbury Honeybeach Hotel to acknowledge their faults, rectify the situation, and prevent similar incidents from occurring in the future. AVOID these cunning places.

Bill
Screenshots of chats & Emails

title: Disappointing Experience: A Chaotic Valentine's Day Dinner Buffet at The Kingsbury Hotel
text:
Dear The Kingsbury Hotel,
I am writing to express my extreme dissatisfaction and frustration with the level of service I received during the Valentine's Day Dinner Buffet at the Harbour Court Restaurant. I made a reservation for two people on the 12th of February, well in advance of the event, and paid the full amount for the dinner, expecting a warm and enjoyable experience. However, what I experienced was far from that.
Upon arriving, my partner and I had to wait on a waiting list for more than 40 minutes before being seated, despite having made a reservation well in advance. The wait was frustrating and set the tone for the rest of the evening. Once we were finally seated, we were shocked to find that the restaurant itself was a complete mess with no hotel ambiance, and it lacked proper organization. It was cluttered, and the seating arrangements were haphazardly arranged, making it difficult to move around or to even get to the buffet table.
The quality of the seating provided was also extremely poor. Instead of being seated at a proper table and chairs, we were given a plastic table and two plastic chairs, which was completely unacceptable for a supposed 5-star hotel. The lack of attention to detail was shocking, and the entire atmosphere felt like a cheap roadside food stall.
Furthermore, during the dinner, there was an incident where a group of five people shouted at the management. 
To make matters worse, I couldn't believe my eyes when I saw that the same group of people who were shouting at the management were immediately rewarded with a free champagne bottle. It was insulting to witness such preferential treatment, especially after waiting for so long to be seated and then being served in such an unprofessional manner. It's unacceptable to see that The Kingsbury Hotel is rewarding bad behavior and providing subpar service to its customers. This experience has left a bad taste in my mouth, and I hope that you will take my feedback seriously and make the necessary improvements to ensure that this doesn't happen to anyone else in the future.

I have been to many hotels in Colombo, but I have never experienced such poor organization and service. I am sharing this review to inform others about your lack of professionalism and disregard for customers' comfort and satisfaction when it comes to organizing events. It's a shame that you focus on profit rather than the quality of experience that your customers deserve.
I do not want any apologies or free services; I want you to focus on treating your customers with respect and providing them with quality experiences. Your level of service was far below what I expected from a reputed 5-star hotel, and I am extremely disappointed with the service I received at The Kingsbury Hotel.
Sincerely, Chanaka Fernando

title: Our Wedding @ Kingsbury
text:
Our experience @ The Kingsbury was our wedding. Planning and dealing with some staff members And the unpredictable price changes ( We had to pay 40% extra per pax than what was discussed earlier) were frustrating. 

If you are required to deal with Andrea W., Senior Manager - Banquet Sales, it is advisable to find another venue. As stress she would cause is not worth it. Andrea is excellent at not responding to any emails in a timely manner, hanging up phone calls in the midst of a conversation without a resolution or an outcome, not showing up to pre-arranged meetings for final discussions, constantly leaving and attending to other matters during a discussion, and ruining the experience from the very beginning. You would have to deal with one of the most uncooperative, irresponsible, and unprofessional few staff members.
 
So if you do not want to be ill-treated, stressed and frustrated, I recommend finding a wedding venue somewhere else. 

If you are not used to the humid weather in Sri Lanka, you will not enjoy your wedding and photoshoot at The Kingsbury. As a cost-cutting method, they do not switch on air conditioners in the morning in common areas. As a result, the common areas where you find most photo locations are stuffy and hot in the morning. You will sweat, and your makeup will be ruined. 

In addition, although Kingsbury has no control over this, you will not get any sleep these days due to the constant slogans projected through loudspeakers by nearby political demonstrators.

title: Incompetent and Substandard
text:
My name is Ravi and I am staying in room 412 at the time of writing this review. This has been a let down right from the time I checked in and is a disappointment especially considering the price paid. This is a 2 star hotel in any international city and even here, I certainly don't think it can be rated higher than 3 stars.

1: I was asked to wait for my room for 20 minutes or so without any offer of a beverage or even a glass of water. No big deal, I understand sometimes things are busy. Welcome drink was indeed offered when I walked back to the front desk and asked for a drink while I waited.

2: There was no refrigerator in the room. Seriously. House-keeping came to show me where they keep the fridge, and when they opened the door marked mini-bar, the space was empty. So they installed a fridge for me after a few hours, and of course it was an empty fridge. No beverages inside, certainly not a mini bar. Is this really a 5 star hotel?

3: Poorly managed breakfast billing system. Staff asked me repeatedly what my room number was despite my telling them loud and clear while entering.

These things happened more than once so not a one off.

And they botch up the bill, they have no idea whether 1 or 2 guests ate breakfast, and then when they finally do present the proper bill, they don't know if it is full board or not. They wasted my time saying it was full board at first even when I said it wasn't, then chasing after me in public in the lobby to pay the bill when they discovered that I had to pay for it indeed.

4: This is the most recent and the one which irritated me enough to go ahead and write this review. I've ordered a King Prawns Biryani to my room. The room service guy insisted I only had to sign for it and not pay cash, despite my offering to pay him. And sure enough, he comes back 10 minutes later while I am in the middle of my meal to say 'sir, back office said take the money.' 

5. Also noteworthy is the daily loud party that goes on until midnight at the poolside. I don't like it and I suspect those who like peace and quiet will not either.

I don't want to get anyone in any trouble, I believe the Sri Lankan people as a whole are very friendly and nice people. But I am sorry to say Kingsbury that your billing system, staff and perhaps the back office are all very poorly trained and disorganized. This is not a professionally run establishment, it is amateur hour and a good 40-50% of the staff don't seem to have their hearts invested in their jobs and/or are very poorly trained. You don't know what you are doing, it's sad.

I seek no apologies or communication about this review, please just try to minimize further incompetence until I check out tomorrow.

To readers, save your money- this is a poorly run 2 or 3 star experience. Only the steak was nice at the Kings Steakbar, excellent service there (and delicious Creme Brulee). I would advice you to stay elsewhere and perhaps just come here to eat if you must.

title: Come to ground floor restaurants,  sleep somewhere else (hopefully without wedding gift covid)
text:
I'm not sure where to start?

We've stayed here three times and this will be our last, sadly.

Sunday brunch is good! As is the fish restaurant. The Chinese on ground floor is also excellent. 

But...

The facilities are ok, but nothing exceptional. We stay in executive rooms (8th floor) and some rooms are clearly old with tough carpets and mattress than you roll in to the pre made groove, others are soft carpet and newer. All are small. I mean small. Outside of a ferry these are incredibly small rooms. Shower is good though, no random temp changes.

Get this: you can't relax on the sofas by the pool during the afternoon, we've just been asked to move so they can clean, presumably for the evening parties. Also, no beer available at either of the two bars by the pool during the afternoon.  You can get a beer but you have to walk inside the hotel and get yourself - that's right, now waiter service by the pool in the afternoon, how's that for "5 star"?!

First visit here there was a VERY loud argument between 2 of the staff in the Chinese. Proper screaming and shouting.  Then told we could not enter roof top bar as I had shorts on, there was no mention of this in the brochures or anywhere! Ironic as we eventually bullied our way in and it was empty so, I'm not sure who my male knobbly 47 year old knees were going to offend.

Second time the Japanese restaurant the Ramen was INCREDIBLY salty. We asked for a less salty attempt and they would not insisted that it's normal. My wife who has lived in Japan and loves Ramen would disagree!

Third and final time. Weddings are now allowed again and the place is full of Covid "don't give a sheetz" wedding parties. Despite facemasks being law none of the younger wedding party guest where them, ANYWHERE.  Also, do NOT stay on the 8th floor (executive shoe boxes) as the music from the roof is BOOM BOOM BOOM all the way past 11pm. Dispite strong complaints the hotel staff will push you away with platitudes and not actually do anything.

Then the next morning the wedding parties will all meet each other in the corridors where the rooms are, starting at 6am, which means you are also awake, like it or not.

Don't stay here. Visit the restaurants (except the Japanese) and stay somewhere else.

title: AN ABSOLUTELY HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE
text: The hotel is not at all kids friendly and parents with young children will be severely discriminated by the management at this establishment. I went to this hotel on 21/02/2021 with one of my friends who had two daughters of 6 years and 3 years. After having supper at Honey Beach Club, me and my mate decided to have a beer at the Kings Steakbar at the same establishment. While we were having our beer, the manager at the Steakbar, Mr. Wenderman, came and very rudely informed us that the bar was a fine dinning venue (even though they had a bar counter and was serving beer out of tap) and our kids were making too much noice. The two kids did not enter the bar at any time, and was playing with some other kids outside the bar. there were only two other guests with us in the bar at that time and they did not seemed to have even noticed the kids. The hotel management was even unable to properly explain any party who have made a complaint against our kids behaviour. Even though the minor staff was very humble and accommodating, we were discussed by the arrogant behaviour of the senior management. We frequent many of the hotels in Colombo and have never experienced such rude treatment by hotel employees, let alone the senior management, before. We immediately paid for our purchase and vacated the premises wowing never to return to this establishment any more. I personally think that the way we were treated at Kingsbury hotel is very discriminating and strongly recommend any parent with young children not to visit this hotel as that is not an experience any parent should undergo. There are many other kids friendly hotels in Colombo and I'm sure they will accommodate parents with young children than the Kingsbury would do. title: Service Has Dropped
text:
We are regular visitors here and as such that implies we must like the place, and we do. Since the bomb blast last April naturally a few alterations have been made as well as a few that were planned anyway. 

Having booked directly with the hotel months back our intial observations were disappointing as I had booked 2 rooms, one for my wife and I and one for my brother and his wife, yet were charged two different rates by 2 different payment methods. I think when my brother paid they simply converted the $ rate to £ yet for mine for some reason they converted it to Sri Lankan Rupees and then to Pounds resulting in me paying £40 more for the same thing. This is just wrong and needs a consistent approach.

We also didn't get the Galle Face road view rooms we had booked instead were on 7th floor, and facing the pool area and the noise they describe as music making it hard to get to sleep, additionally our sleep was disturbed by noisy guests returning at 4:15am and being inconsiderate of others being asleep, as such our first nights sleep was not good despite very comfortable beds. The housekeeping day shift must start at 6am and it can be noisy in the corridor as they collect trays or start cleaning the rooms of guest who have checked out overnight.

I have reviewed the hotel several times before over several visits and still breakfast seems to be an issue for them. As some things are cooked fresh, timing of when you order eggs, sausage etc is key, especially if you want everything hot at the same time and as the pre cooked beans and bacon are not hot to start off with and the hash browns seem to lack potato (I suspect overcooked). Order your tea or coffee AFTER you go for your food because I'll guarantee it will be cold when you get if you order before by the time you get back to your table. The hot plates the beans etc stand on don't  seem to be switched on so I asked for my beans to be heated up only to get them after the rest of my breakfast was finished or it too would have been cold. Breakfast remains a low scorer for me.

Food and service in the other restaurants we ate at in the hotel was lovely.

The pool area has been renovated and is very nice although music is too loud in the evening for us and there is not really a simple bar to sit in the hotel in the evening that isn't part of a restaurant if you fancy a quiet drink in an airconditioned room. Food and drink service by the pool improved during the week and the pool/towel guys were always helpful and friendly, Roland especially was very helpful and encouraged us to use the steam and sauna rooms as well as the spa treatments and is worth mention and praise.

Rooms were slow to be cleaned and we had to go and find towels on occasions as none were left after cleaning, indeed nor were spare toilet rolls. That said, part of the reason may have been we weren't made aware of the switches by the bed to say the room is ready for cleaning or do not disturb, in fairness, it did get better once we started using them and the lads who do the cleaning were all friendly and helpful. Beds were very comfortable and large and generally we slept very well, the rooms are also spotless.

There has been a lot of facebook publicity on the opening of the new restaurants which all look great but perhaps at the expense of service, although front desk staff remain very helpful (payment methods excluded). 

We have always returned to The Kingsbury based on past experiences, and I would still recommend it, but perhaps a change for us next time is needed based on this experience.

Yesterday morning (around 9:00) tried to reserve a high tea in the evening for two “high tea voucher” i had then they informed me that they have canceled the high tea (one month after purchase of the voucher) and its possible to utilize them in the lunch or dinner and said will call back in a few min after checking with the finance dpt.

I waited until 12:00 since i didn't get any response I call them back then the gentleman who answered informed me they are still waiting for a response from finance dpt. So I waited.

Finally they gave me a call in the 13:00 and informed me that I had to come the next day ( Monday) and first need to convert them to a cash voucher then i can use on a dinner or lunch. This was not the answer I was expecting and the problem is twofold.    

1. Voucher is an agreement between client and customer. As we they also need to adhere to that. If not atlasest provide the value in cash which i asked and declined.

2. If they are going to cancel any of their services or product they must have a clear alternative plans for the customers without wasting time that already paid for those services since we are the party that asked for the discontinuation of the service .
