We are pleased to learn that you enjoyed our international breakfast buffet at Harbour Court Restaurant.

We appreciate your valuable comments and feedback which help us continuously strive to achieve greater heights! Thank you for patronage and we do hope we get the opportunity of welcoming you back very soon!

Warmest Regards,

Scott Mawhinney
General Manager
The Kingsbury

title: Aging and noisy property
text: As repeat guests to the hotel we were disappointed to see how much the property had aged in just under 2 years. The hotel was very kind in offering us an early check in which we appreciated very much. Stayed there for 3 nights and needed a quiet getaway, but the experience was far from it. We were on the 8th floor, and suffered disturbance from the floor above which I think houses a ballroom. The noise went into inconvenient hours of the night which wasn't fun. Didn't help either that we had a pool view room where the noise from the band at the pool hits us from downstairs as well. The staff are very alert and ready to help though and offered to change rooms, but the views from the higher floor are much better.  Breakfast at the hotel is a "big" breakfast in all sense of the word with a huge variety and live stations. Staff at breakfast need to be complimented because it is not often that you walk into a breakfast hall with smiling welcoming faces across the board (from hostess to the chef). This experience turned a full 360 when we decided to use the all day dining restaurant for dinner, when the host couldn't even be bothered to seat us. They were busy and appeared to us as though they are not used to managing a crowd. So we decided to try the Chinese restaurant at the hotel. The food here was amazing, but lacked the "experience" charms that go with dining at a 5* hotel. The restaurant manager who  also doubled up as a host and seated us to our table failed to inform us of the two different types of menus he handed us (one being sri-lankan chinese and the other being schezwan chinese), we asked for the table lighting to be lit where otherwise this should happen when we are sat, our server (bless him, loved his honesty) couldn't tell our dumplings apart and had to check-in with the chef who didn't have a clue either so we waited for a fresh set so that all parties knew which was which. Even before we finished our meal the restaurant started prepping furniture and layouts for a very busy mothers day set up for the following day. So while the food got our full points, it did not feel like we were having anything close to a 5* experience. We fell in love with the kingsbury during our first stay and thats why choose it this time around; for our next stay... may have to look around for something more suited to our taste.

management_response.text:
Dear RichardDevadasan,

Greetings from The Kingsbury!

Thank you for taking the time to review your experience at The Kingsbury on Tripadvisor! We are greatly disappointed to learn that your stay at The Kingsbury was below the level of service we strive to maintain. Please accept our sincere apologies at not being able to live up to the level of confidence placed in us. We appreciate and value your feedback and it helps us in our continuous efforts to serve you better. It is our aim to create delightful guest experiences consistently and we have made note of your points and concerns and have taken necessary steps to rectify those issues.

We are delighted to learn that you enjoyed our International breakfast buffet at Harbour Court Restaurant and also that the food at the Yue Chuan gets full points. We welcome the opportunity to speak to you directly and discuss this further should you be willing to do so. 

Thank you for your valued patronage and for sharing your experience with us. We look forward to hearing from you soon!

Warmest Regards,

Scott Mawhinney
General Manager
The Kingsbury

title: Good Food but disappointed
text: Yesterday we want to book Yue Chuan Chinese restaurant for 18 packs Lunch. After booking received a SMS confirming the bookings. We called back to check whether we could bring a Birthday Cake since yesterday is my Son's Birthday. Called the Mob no mentioned in the SMS. After repeated calls no was answered. When we requested to bring the Birthday cake person who answered requested Rs. 2,500 as charges. We were disappointed with the reaction and decided to celebrate without a cake.  The reason we still came is food is good,  We ordered our food but the professional guidance and training for Stewards were lacking. We had 18 pax but not a single supervisor or a restaurant Mgr spoke to us.  When we ordered the food we requested warm water and normal water. We were served with bottle water. When the bill came hotel has charged Rs. 500 per bottle. Our water bill was Rs. 2,500.  Food was very good. Food prices were reasonable. Restaurant atmosphere best in the town. It is pity that above 2 incidents upset the whole good experience.  Request General Manager of the hotel to look into this. Knowing the brand well we ere sure if the higher authorities know these they will correct these immediately . We love good local brands.

management_response.text:
Dear Sanjeewa A,

Greetings from The Kingsbury!

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience on Tripadvisor! We deeply regret the inconvenience caused. Given the fact that your experience has been well below the high standard of service we strive to maintain at The Kingsbury, naturally we are disappointed and saddened that we were unable to live up to the level of confidence placed in us and that your experience was well below the delightful experience we always try to provide our guests.
We are happy to learn however that the food and atmosphere were to your liking.
We value and appreciate your comments and feedback as it helps us to continuously improve our guest service and staff training. We would be very pleased and welcome you to get in touch with us if you would be willing to discuss this matter further.

Thanking you once again for your feedback and valuable patronage! We look forward to hearing from you.

Warmest Regards,

Scott Mawhinney
General Manager
The Kingsbury

title: Unethical Behavior
text:
Took money from my credit card, apologized and then accidentally copied me in an internal mail where they suggest I get black listed. 

My trip was fully paid for so they have no reason to block me. I've got all of this communication in writing and taking legal action against them for threatening me like this.

Stay away!

title: Good choice in Colombo
text:
The first hand impression of The Kingsbury was very nice. We approached the hotel counter at the airport, by chance and coincidence only, and a modern taxi was arranged for us within 5 minutes without any pre-booking or anything. The staff was very helpful. 
The rooms are not top-notch, but for Colombo standard, it doesnt get much better than this. The location of the hotel is great, as it is lies within the old colonial centre of Colombo, only a block away from the presidential palace. There is a nice ocean view from the hotel, although the usual great view from the pool area is presently partly blocked by some breakwater construction along the coastline. 
The lobby area is a bit of a mess unfortunately as there is a restaurant, a cafe and a bar crammed into a small space. 
We were unfortunately very disappointed with the Concierge service as we asked recommendations for a nice local and authentic Sri Lankan restaurant. The Concierge send us to the worst ever tourist trap with bad and over-priced food. Not what you expect from a Concierge service at a 5-star hotel.

title: A King's adobe with some issues
text:
It really is a lavish place and looks like an old royal building converted to a hotel. The lobbies and view are really nice. Beach is nearby within walking distance. Why I am not rating it as a 4* experience as we had an issue with our meal plan and the hotel staff was not aware of it. This was a total put off as I never expect this out of a 5* property. 
On the bright side, the food is good and range is as lavish and long as you can think of.

title: accomodation
text:
Disgusing rooms!! dont stay here
The staff were ok, appears to be businness centre, stopover 1 night and move on.
I book on reading the reviews on trip advisor which was very disappointing.
I will not recommend this hotel to anyone.

title: A Very Bad Experience
text: Though we were recommended this hotel as one of the best in Colombo but our experience was not nice . First the service in the buffet area for breakfast was pathetic , service is word not known to the staff there . We had to wait 10 minutes to just get a FORK ! We had breakfast for 2 days and on either days not one wait staff offered us even a glass of water ! It spoilt our mood for the whole time we were in Sri lanka

title: Oh dear........
text:
The exterior gives you an impression of excellence. Internally it's a bit a shambles with staff not knowing what's going on, confusion reigns and the bubble of top hotel in the region is popped.
The room is small (but big enough for 2 adults) and the view of the land reclamation is great for want-to-be engineers. 
The bed is comfortable and the wifi is fast though - which is nice......

title: Disgusting local discrimination
text:
My wife and I were disgusted today when we visited The Kingsbury and asked if we could pay to use the pool as we had last year when we were here. We were asked how many, and I replied that there were three of us, my wife, myself and a friend we were travelling with. The desk clerk replied that it was OK for my wife and I, but that locals (Sri Lankans) were not allowed. 
I questioned this and he motioned for me to wait until he finished dealing with another customer. When he had finished he said that he had spoken to his manager, which was a lie because he hadn't left the desk or spoken to anyone else while we were there, and that the "house policy" was that Sri Lankans and children were banned from using the pool because they "pollute it".
We were embarrassed for the way our friend was humiliated by this statement and assured the desk clerk that we would be commenting about the disgusting and discriminatory attitude. 
We won't be using this hotel while the discrimination against locals continues.

title: Good, but certain big issues!
text:
I am currently staying at this hotel. The hotel overall and the room are good. However, their approach to food and comprehension levels are poor, to say the least, for a hotel of this calibre. 
Their breakfast is supposed to be great, but one wouldn't know first hand because of a strange system they have - breakfast is buffet only, no a la carte available at the Harbour Court, a la carte available only as room service. So, if you are three people and only one wants to eat a full buffet, you can either uselessly pay for the two other people, or the person who wants the buffet is stuck eating in the room or the one person eats alone. Rather absurd!!
At the Cake, no one seems to know what is part of the high tea buffet and what can be given a la carte. First person says everything can be taken as a la carte, second says nothing can be taken as such, the third says only scones are available a la carte. Good for me, I wanted the scones! Here again, absurd system, and complete inability to understand or communicate.
The food at the Ocean was great in terms of variety but not in terms of taste. Service was good!
The bathroom while great is lacking in counter space and a problem which plagues alot of hotels, no place to hang wet, used towels or clothes.
And there is only one available power point in the room to charge mobile phones, so if there are two people with two phones, then you possibly need to wake up in the middle of the night to swap phones and ensure both are charged.
The view from my room is of the sea, but there is a concrete monstrosity, namely a rather unfinished roof of the hotel, which spoils the view. This could have been made to look pretty in the form of a terrace garden or with proper tiling.

title: May be wrong timing, but not too impressed
text: The hotel looks grand, though is too big so no personal service. Rooms are small, like most colonial hotels. Breakfast spread is really good. We could see beach fireworks on New Year's eve from our hotel room. May be it was the new year time, the service was quite chaotic. We had to go and re-identify our baggage to be sent to our room. Location is good.

title: "Service was horrible at High Tea"
text:
I am a fan of Kingsbury High Tea and Tuesday (22 Mar) myself and wife went there to enjoy an evening together in celebration of her birthday. Had a reservation made on 18 Mar. 

We got a table near the poolside window and the place was too hot to be comfortable. I was sweating and mentioned that to the guy who served us. 

And when a bunch of tourists came and occupied the next table to ours, hotel was kind to put a fan for them. They were constantly glancing at us and ignoring because I think we were locals.

Overall food was superb as usual but the poor service ruined it all for us.

title: Too busy to give attention
text:
We had two night at this hotel in Presidential suite. We were quite disappointed about this stay. The website says that we will "be treated like royalty", but this service was not royal at all. Check-in took too long, no priority, not a warm welcome. Hardly anyone knew that we had the hotels best room. We could not get a proper table in the restaurant, or sky lounge. In executive floor we had to stay in the hall way or asked to take the food to our room.

Suite was clean and comfortable. Butler was a nice guy, but his appearance was missing. From the rates you pay you really imagine more. The Kinsbury can learn from other hotels in Sri Lanka that takes care of their guest in far better ways.

Unfortunately we will not be back in this hotel for a romantic stay.

title: Poor pre-booking customer service
text: BEWARE as this doesn't feel like a 5 start hotel booking experience - Made a booking and have received no confirmation of my booking, additionally there is no option to view the reservation account either. The booking had a special offer with free breakfast however confirmation doesnt give any details. Emailed them but no response. Want to cancel the booking and there is no option.

title: Good but.....
text: Arrived after a long drive and had a very pleasant experience with the check in. We were booked into rooms on the 4th floor but once I mentioned that Tripadvisor comment were to get 8th floor rooms they changed our booking. Dinner in the Chinese restaurant was a very pleasant experience as was a short swim and drinks at the pool. Second day however was a nightmare. Started off by the hotel lobby looking more like a train station than a 5 star hotel lobby. The noise was unbelievable! As we stepped out the hotel we were met by a man saying he was hotel staff and suggested we go down the the market where everything was half price today.....being our 8th day in Sri Lanka we were well aware that this was just another trap for us to spend money! Anyway after a morning of sightseeing in Colombo we decided to relax next to the pool. This was impossible due to the pool being occupied by some 80 children armed with water pistols having a birthday party at the pool. The kids filled the pool and all the parents occupied the chairs around the pool. Decided then to book a couples massage at the spa. Told to come down immediately was fine. When we got down we find that it was overbooked and we had to wait another hour. All this with shouting children having fun around us using the bathrooms. The room was very stuffy and smelt of mound. The temptation to open the window was great! All in all an ok stay but would not recommend it for a holiday hotel but perhaps perfectly situated for a business visit.

title: Noises and children's party.
text:
3 weeks in Sri Lanka should have ended with some luxury in this 5 stare hotel. But the lobby was like a train station, noise and lot of people. We should have enjoyed the pool area, but the area was occupied by 80 children for a B-day. They started 3 hours before either the preparation, and afterward the party started😡 after several hour we decided to go to our room instead. When we asked for competition, since we were not informed about this kind of party when we booked, after some discussion, they offered a water as discounts. 
Don't use the hotel if you expect some lovely luxury, since these party are normal in the hotel - we talks to others that has have same experience 

To the hotel: if you book so many party's as we now heard of, you need to have separated room for that. So you can give your gust what you promise: spa, luxury and so on! 

For video of the crazy kids B-day see: familiennielsen on Instagram.

title: The least friendly 5 star resort I have witnessed
text:
I stayed in this hotel as I wanted a spot of luxury after a running event I undertook. The place looks stunning and is in an excellent location.  It has all of the ingredients to be a great hotel; but it isn't.  And here's why (in my opinion/experience):

1.  I was asked at reception if I wanted a non smoking or smoking room.  I told the young man I wanted non smoking to which he replied; oh we only have smoking left. This was disgusting and the room stank of smoke.

2.  Reception itself was a ridiculous ordeal. Everything took far too long and the staff were lethargic and sullen.

3.  Breakfast was delicious but the experience was atrocious. After waiting for 15 minutes to get in,  there wasn't a seat available for me.  I asked one of the waiters to sort one out and he walked me to a table full of plates, removed one of them and asked me to sit. He later returned to clear the rest but didn't bring me any cutlery. I had to catch him again just to get a fork to eat my food. This might seem like a small detail but it certainly isn't 5 star service. 

The rest of the hotel was fine and it is such a shame it has been ruined by these very basic and extremely avoidable issues.  

Simply not good enough.

title: 5 star ...NOT !!!
text:
Not the warm welcome one would expect from a 5 star hotel....hence a disappointing start to our vacation. Staff failed to give eye contact at check in and there was no evidence of "service with a smile"
Our rooms were on the Executive floor which was nice because of the private lounge and the service in here was very good however, be warned if your room happens to be on the left side of the elevator as you will be disturbed til the early hours of the morning from the music and noise in the bar upstairs...
The hotel are aware of this but they fail to tell you this and I was finally offered a different room on my third night.
Light bulbs missing in the room, and complimentary fruit was given in one room only,( we had 2 rooms) hence no consistency...beds were not made to my expectation either but they were comfortable.
Buffet breakfast in the main dining area was not sufficiently refilled and since we went down, 30 minutes before closing, we were left with dregs of a cooked breakfast which was only  luke warm.
A half hearted apology for the 2 night inconvenience and the only compensation was a free late check out and a last minute offer of a free transfer to airport, but as we had already made arrangements, the transfer offer was too little too late.
Would I visit this hotel again - NO, and neither would I whole heartedly recommend it to my friends and family.

title: Nice Hotel But Quite Some Weaknesses
text:
The hotel itself is quite nice, a business hotel with a pool, a gym, and a roof-top bar. The room we booked (a suite) was space and convenient. The restaurants in the hotel have good food. 
BUT, the service was by far below what we expected: when we ordered items like additional towels, tissues etc we always needed to request it multiple times!  We reserved a car operated by the hotel to get to the resort we booked for the weekend and they simple forgot the reservation. So, be carful if you depend on the driver really being there!
Finally, for the first night we got a suite at the third floor - and it was just above the terrace of one of the restaurants. It was so noise until 3am in the morning that we couldn't sleep. So, we moved to another suite at the fifth floor was a bit better, but still it was not quiet. Thus, we would recommend to NOT book a suite with ocean view although the view is nice, the sleep is more important.

title: 5 Star hotel.... Far from it. Worst service ever
text: Been Valentines day we thought of taking a break from the usual Hilton’s and try a different location for a change. The advertisement looked appealing so we thought of trying the Pool Café’s ‘Extravagant BBQ’. Although we made a reservation there no one to greet us & after standing for around 10 min I had to wave and get the attention of a staff member to direct us to a table. There was no décor to even create the some sort of ambience been Valentine’s day. The tables were dark. Drinks were served promptly. However no one came and served us thereafter. There were several tables were the clearance had not been done and was not pleasing to the eye. The buffet area seemed messy and was not well lit. Food tags were scattered all over the place. Had to indicate to the chef that some of the chaffing dishes were empty. No clearance was done during the entire meal and not one waiter or manager even came to the area where we were. The desert buffet was half empty and no one bothered to replenish the counter promptly. Had to wait a while until some brought refills. No one came to give us the bill and we had to walk towards the cashier and ask for the bill. I was so irritated that I expressed my views to one of the managers (Indika) who did not bother to offer any apology.

title: Great room but poor service
text: The rooms are really nice. The swimming pool is slightly old. The hospitality is one of the worst. The staff dont even smile. I was told is because im not a white tourist. I had to ask them to take my luggage once i got down.

title: Good, but annoyingly slow check-in og much noise
text:
After arrival it took a lot of time registering and finally getting the room key og having the luggage brought to the room, partly because of a wedding reception. As the hotel has several receptions of this kind every day they should not delay other guests -- this is not good enough service at a hotel that claims to be first-class. The room was rather small but staying only one night we really didn't miss anything except an airy balcony. 

We had an excellent breakfast with waste choices of everything and enjoyed a few hours by and in the pool, given splendid service even after we had cheched out with several hours to pass until our plane left -- a shower just before leaving for the airport was very refreshing in 33 humid degrees.

A minus was that we at 10 in the evening were directed to an empty bar for a glass of wine in stead of having it in the lively eatery. There was an alternative bar but it was also deserted, propably because of the terrible noise called music. The rooftop bar had similar entertainment, making it impossible to have a conversation. The bar prices are far higher than in most places in Colombo.

The hotel brag about the nice wiev over the Indian ocean. When we visited it was very much a reduced joy because of immense construction works going on along the whole beach in front of the hotel and to the Southern side.

management_response.text:
Dear Eirik-44,

Whilst we thank for giving us this feedback, its most unfortunate you stay had not been ideal. Please accept our apologies! We ask that you kindly bear with us till Port City construction is over in the name of development in Colombo.

With warm regards and best wishes,
Dinithi

title: Reservation department mess
text:
The last time we were in Colombo we stayed at the Hilton but ate at the Kingsbury twice and were impressed by the service. It has a great buffet and is centrally located. So, as we are planning to visit Colombo for a few days around New Year's Eve, I wanted to book two interconnecting rooms. I called the reservations department prior to booking the room and they advised that the interconnecting rooms were available in all rooms except suites. I went ahead and booked the room. Their response to my email was that the interconnecting rooms cannot be guaranteed as they are subject to availability which is a direct contradiction of what they said to me telephonically. I feel as though they wasted my time and money on am international call as I had to cancel the booking as I informed them when confirming the interconnecting rooms. 
If they fail to deliver now already, what will the stay be like?

management_response.text:
Dear Aneesa P,
Please accept our sincere apologies in this regard, you were misinformed initially as not all rooms have inter-connecting rooms. Subsequent communication to you was accurate but we do regret the limitation of such rooms and the pain of mind caused to you in this regard.

We wish you a pleasant stay in Colombo and if time permits to visit The Kingsbury, please let me know at dinithi@thekingsburyhotel.com

With warm regards and best wishes,
Dinithi

title: Good stay in Colombo, very good price/value ratio
text:
The price is decent for the quality you get from this hotel.

There is some construction work infront of the hotel, and thus the pool area did not match my expecations.
They have a good spa, the breakfast was OK, the location is good. The overall quality was good, but not as good as my expectations when i arrived in the lobby. 

The sea-food restaurant was fantastic - best sea-food restaurant I tried in Sri Lanka(and I tried a few). 

It is the perfect last weekend hotel after you have done the beaches down south and hiking inland.

management_response.text:
Dear BoxmaT,

Thank you for having chosen The Kingsbury, we are delighted to note you have found some respite and enjoyed a perfect weekend.

We look forward to welcoming you back, hope your travels will bring you back to The Kingsbury.

With warm regards and best wishes,
Dinithi

title: Unfortunately, name and perception well surpass its actual
text:
Overall hotel quality is very poor. The hotel car that was supposed to pick us had a puncture. They have organised another car from a tour agent. However, half way, he ran out of petrol. Went to put petrol in a station late at 1130pm already after a tiring flight. 

We were checked in to room 722 and room 523. While walking towards the room, all the hallways had lights that were blinking and very uncomfortable.

Their so-called Premium rooms has a pillar in the middle blocking a small view of the sea. It is also a room of odd angle because this room was wrapping a service area. Terrible choice and not fair to charge more.

The fitting in the rooms were horrible, fungus and wet wall. very badly worn out walls and dirty. Although providing Bvlgari amenities, they had a shower+body gel combined liquid. It should be the usual 3, shampoo, conditioner and shower gel?

One thing good was the shower pressure, very strong and good.

Checked out only after a night. Their staff did persuade us to stay, we were beyond disappointment. 

Would not recommend at all!

management_response.text:
Dear Tai Q,
It's with much regret we note that your stay had not gone well. Please accept  our sincere apologies. We would like to suggest that if ever you are not satisfied with any of our services/facilities, please do to let us know about it while you are in-house to allow us to make it up to you.

With warm regards and best wishes,
Dinithi

title: Amazing Looking Hotel
text: Wow this hotel is amazing very nice rooms and the restaurant has amazing food. The customer service is very slow and little disorganised. House keeping service call at the rooms at 8.00am to clean your room which is way to early. The cafe and bar at the hotel is very nice. The hotel also has a roof top bar was has amazing views.But overall lovely hotel just too pricing and customer service needs improvement.

management_response.text:
Dear Natasha P,

Thank you for having taken the time to share your experience, whilst we note your delight, your concerns too have been addressed. We hope your travels will bring you back to Colombo and The Kingsbury.

With best wishes,
Dinithi

title: The rooms are tired
text:
We stayed at the Kingsbury Hotel on our final night in Sri Lanka hoping to 'live it up' on our last night. The location also appealed to us since it was close to the Dutch Hospital and very central. 

When we arrived in our room on the 7th floor, our first impressions were that the room was pokey and generally pretty tired looking. The furniture was chipped, carpet was old and there was paint chipping off the walls and also cracks. We were pretty disappointed given we'd used up almost a 1/3 of our credit card rewards points to stay there, but we realised it was just a matter of choosing an old hotel that was in need of refurbishment and there was nothing much we could do. After unpacking and showering, we began to notice how unclean the room was. There was mold on the roof in the bathroom, water stains above the air conditioning, stains on the cupboards and dust on the mirrors and lamp shades. I would have expected that room of a 2-3 star hotel but never a 5 star hotel. 

After discovering that the room was not only tired, but also unclean, I called to make a complaint. Management upgraded us to the executive level and a new room. It was still tired but was much cleaner than the last so we were happy. What astonished me was that management seemed surprised that I complained about the cleanliness of the room. We are by no means pedantic or fussy and I find it hard to believe that people would put up with that standard of room in a 5 star hotel. I don't know, maybe we were just put in a very poor room because we used rewards points, but even in the executive room, I wasn't super impressed. 

With all that said, the pool is lovely (despite the current waterfront development blocking the view of the beach) and we spent a really nice final afternoon there. The service was generally good and they did upgrade us promptly when discovering we were unhappy. 

We love Sri Lanka and Colombo, and our stay was by no means terrible, but the Kingsbury is in need of a face lift, asap.

management_response.text:
Dear Tarossa,

Whilst we express our regrets in this regard, we assure you the high standards we maintain at The Kingsbury will not be compromised. This is a most unfortunate occurrence and I reiterate our our sincere apologies in this regard. 

Best wishes and regards,
Dinithi

title: Disappointing Accommodation but Beautiful Food
text:
My wife and I stayed at the Kingsbury Hotel in Colombo for Three Nights. It was recommended by a friend; so we thought we'll give it a try. 
The Hotel is located virtually in the heart of the City Central, at the far City End of the Galle Face Green. 
We were greeted by the door man with a beaming smile, which made us feel very welcome. The Reception area however, turned out to be pretty average. The reception staff on the day, were "coldly" efficient, but not overly friendly. The check in process however was efficient & business like and cannot be complained.
We went up the elevator to the fifth floor & along a not so well lit passage to our room.
The room itself was pretty small compared to the other major hotels we have stayed in. Once the King size bed was plonked in the room, there was hardly any space to move. I don't know much of the history or background to the Hotel, but it appeared to be an Old Building, where someone has made a valiant but not a very successful attempt at modernising the Room.
We had a "sort" of an Ocean view room. Sure we could see the Ocean at a distance, but there appeared to be quite a lot of construction work going on, which did not help the view. Moreover looking out from the window of our room, there was a great big concrete slab a few floors down, which certainly, was not a pleasant sight. 
The Bathroom was clean, but pretty average.
We had the Buffet Breakfast in the downstairs Dining Room all three mornings. I must say that the Dining Room was excellent, well set up & quite impressive. The Spread was also pretty good with all the Western, Asian & Sri Lankan Cuisine one expects. 
The Restaurant staff were excellent, ever ready to help, efficient, polite & made us feel very welcome.
One particular chef ( I think his name was Jayasinghe - I hope I got the name right ) was one of the most polite & efficient people I have met in my travels. The Sri Lankan Food was excellent. 
As I said to my wife, whether I would like to stay again in this hotel is debatable; but I certainly would like to have breakfast here, if I am in the vicinity.

management_response.text:
Dear Kingsleyhe,

We are glad you have immensely enjoyed the food but we are extreme sorry the accommodation has not met with your approval. We take immense pride in providing the best of facilities and luxury amenities with your comfort and pleasure in mind and we assure you of friendly, Sri Lankan smiles should you choose The Kingsbury again.

With best wishes and regards,
Dinithi

title: Procey stylish hotel with lots going on
text:
We stayed here last night.
It is impressively slick when you arrive (enormous bouquets, smart bellboys etc). It is an hour from the airport.

This is a busy hotel. We stayed on a Thursday and it had 2 weddings, one kept us up with music all night with incredibly loud music. When we left this morning there was another one starting.It is very popular for business and has lots of business men and conferences. 

Our room was small but nice, with just a shower. The full wall windows are a nice touch, ours overlooked various building work but also the sea and Galle Face. 

They have a lot of choice for restaurant. We enjoyed a drink at Skybar on the rooftop, watching the sunset, followed by a good meal in their Chinese restaurant. Breakfast was an enormous buffet catering to every cuisine and taste- impressive. 

Flashy, comfortable, decent food but can be noisy.

management_response.text:
Dear Jessica B,

title: Terrible Service
text:
We checked in on 10/01/2015 and made the booking through booking.com for a twin bedded room. Up on check in (12.30 pm) we were given a room with a king sized bed. We informed the reception that there is a mistake and the hotel informed that we have booked for a triple room. We informed that it wasn't the case and informed the staff that we have the booking confirmation clearly stating a double room. The person who claimed to be the manager informed that they will get a twin bedroom ready by 3 pm. 
We called at 3 pm and the staff member informed that they will call back in 5 minutes. now it's almost 6 pm and no response. 
There is a clear process issue of processing the reservation but there is a more severe case of attending what the guest has paid for.

management_response.text:
Dear Dumindu_Tennakoon,

Please accept our sincere apologies for the inconvenience caused to you. Whilst we had given you an early check in at 12.30pm, the delay in resolving your issue is regrettable. We hope you will be able to give us another opportunity to make it up to you.

With warm regards and best wishes,
Dinithi

title: Not 5* at all
text: I booked the Kingsburry for a change. because it was a 5* facility - I usually stay in the Cinamon Grand.  The rooms were dirty - the lamp had never been dusted, cobwebs around the roof, shabby furniture.  someone had written in pencil on the wall and it was not cleaned in the 5 days i was there.  I complained about the room - moved to another where the housekeeping manager made a point of showing me the other rooms being cleaned -  but they obviously dont clean above the floor level.  The buffet selection was excellent but that was about it.  Hotel taxi overcharged us.  Staff very pleasant but I would never stay in the hotel again or would i recommend it.

management_response.text:
Dear Sonya M,

Please accept our sincere apologies, we are truly sorry it has been below the usual high standards we maintain. Please do take a minute to give your check-in name to dinithi@thekingsburyhotel.com to see if there's anyway we could make it up to you.

With warm regards and best wishes,
Dinithi

title: Great Location.
text:
I stayed with my wife and two sons at the Hotel on new years eve. We were there for three days and attended the new years dinner dance as well.
The overall experience was quite nice. The dinner dance was excellent.
However the concierge service was very poor. The person at the concierge (Gihan) was very rude and obnoxious. As a result we left the hotel with a very bitter taste.

Dear amalpri,
Whilst we offer you our sincere apologies, please note such feedback is taken very seriously to ensure such unfortunate incidents are not repeated. We are glad that you've enjoyed the New Year's Eve Retro Fusion Dance, we hope you will join us again this year.

With warm regards and best wishes,
Dinithi

title: Not value for money at US $330 per night
text: 1st, Came to check in at 3pm, room wasn't available, only checked in at 5pm. Considering paying US $330 per night for 2 adults and kid, there was only 2 inch size shampoo. Breakfast -- fruit juices were more like water with touch of orange etc.. No pre made bacon..had to queue up for bacon....getting a cup of tea took a month of Sundays.

title: A bit noisy but quite OK
text:
Great hotel really, but it is difficult to find a quite spot to have a calm drink at night - might have been the season so - poolside is noisy, top floor was busy with wedding (and what a boom boom) so be sure to ask PROACTIVELY if they will be an event on your night stay as there will be no warning at reservation. !

Service was excellent, room provided great clean and well equipped, check out a bit funny but who cares :-)

We are extremely sorry the hotel had been busy and noisy during your stay. Please accept our sincere apologies.

title: Wedding ceremony and one night stay
text:
Me and Fiance at the time had a wedding followed by one night stay at this hotel.
The banquet service is the worst I have seen for a while. They are massive frauds!! who lied and are refusing to refund our deposit(refundable) after the wedding.
The rooms are smaller thanks depicted on the pictures and the service is average.
The banquet service needs to be replaced by a more courteous, formal and a genuine team.
Never have a big function here!

title: Ridiculous for a five star
text:
It took 10 emails and 4 calls to make the reservation staff understanding what are connecting rooms.  We are a couple travelling with 3 small children and obviously need connecting rooms.  Upon arrival we saw the chaos in the lobby and understood immediately that this was going to be a though stay.  Obviously they had a problem with our reservation because we were invited for "coffee and tea". Then they tried to push us into a second floor smoking suite smelling like a pub, next they offered us rooms right adjoining the car park (room was still not cleaned from the previous guests). where everyone was looking straight into your room - 2nd floor, absolutely NO privacy.
Finally we "bunked" all five of us into 1 room.  They crammed in two additional beds.  We had a standing shower only, 1 piece of soap and one small bottle of shampoo, no hand towels, for the five of us.
Room service ice cream was totally melted, ordering tea was a problem.
Breakfast looks good, but service mediocre, no glasses, no water, no milk, the guy making pancakes and waffles always hiding somewhere else.
The coffee on the "club floor" was good, so was the staff on that floor, but that's not enough to return.

title: Low hygiene standards
text: We checked in very early into Kingsbury hotel paying a half day extra tariff. We directly headed for breakfast after checking into the property . I found a cockroach crawling over the bread slices in the bread basket. The staff simply replaced the bread basket making the cockroach crawling over the bread seem very routine . I was disgusted . Besides , the reception staff tried overcharging / double charging my card when I had already payed for the room with cash on check-in. I yet have been generous with my rating giving this hotel 2 stars on account of their great location and good housekeeping.

management_response.text:

Please accept our sincere apologies in this regard. It's most unfortunate and is not keeping with the high standards we maintain. We have taken all necessary corrective action in this regard and with the front office issue too. 

It's our assurance to that we will not compromise on our standards be it hygiene, honesty or your safety. 

With warm regards and best wishes!
Dinithi

title: Clarify happy hour rules in writing.
text: I went to the rooftop bar at the Kingsbury with my wife, on our honeymoon. We had a great night enjoying cocktails with a good view of Colombo. The barman informed us it was two for one cocktails 5-7pm so we had a few!! The disappointing part was they changed their definition of two for one when the bill arrived. Buy two of the same and get one free, rather than buy any two. When converted to Australian dollars the cocktails are still relatively cheap however I was disappointed with my suspected purposeful ambiguity from staff. I'd still go there again but lesson learnt.

In your case since you have only accepted one free drink due from the first order and a beer along with that, you were billed for the first round and one beer. 

However, irrespective of all of the above, its was your special day that should have gone without any glitches. I will be writing to you personally in this regard.

Dinithi

title: Mixed feelings
text: Well located hotel with comfortable rooms and a good business lounge. Some staff stand out: Asanga at the Club Lounge in particular is highly professional and the housekeeping and laundry staff are so friendly and helpful, taking pride in their work The expertise of the Thai therapists at the spa is very good. However, there are significant downsides. Although there is a lot of choice, the food is not as good as it nearest rival; some of the front of house staff (I hate to say this, but mostly the women) are surly and apart from one or two senior managers, those in the restaurants need training. Finally, don't come here if you are hoping for a decent night's sleep. Like most hotels in Colombo, the KIngsbury is a round the clock events venue with rooms attached. The walls are very thin and preparations take place throughout the night. I am grateful to the staff that changed my rooms, especially the Duty Manager on the night of 29 September whose name I didn't catch but I am not sure I would return. I was on a 12 night business trip but the hotel would be fine for one or two days.

management_response.text:

We are happy to get your feedback and whilst we thank you for the lovely compliments paid to us, we assure the issues you have mentioned too will be addressed.

With warm regards and best wishes,

title: Way too overrated, disappointing service and ambience...
text:
Planned a surprise birthday trip to my husband in Sri Lanka, and although we had stayed in other very good hotels in Colombo before, this time I believed the good comments on the net about this hotel and booked a suit. Overall experience was a total disaster, definitely not recommended especially for a romantic getaway…

Problems started when we reached the hotel after a tiring drive from Kandy. We were taken up to executive lounge to check in. Although we had mentioned a few times that we were tired and needed to go to the room, the check in took about half an hour because of a new registry system they were trying to implement and the tablet was not working properly. I would have preferred to fill in a form manually. The executive lounge also looked so dull, with a few small round tables without any ambience and ice cold temperature.

Then finally we were taken to the room. From the photos on the net, I was expecting ocean view – but it was partial view and the rest was  harbour life behind the pool area. Nothing impressive. Although it was a suit, it had almost the same size of a good hotel standard room. There was only one tv in the small living area and we did not have any chance to watch tv from the bed. They were proudly mentioning about a special movie selection in the brochure, but we couldn’t watch any as if we were punished to pay extra for a suit.  The hand shower in the shower was not working, so I took shower in the bath tub and the water temperature was very unstable. 

Then I booked a massage from the spa. Considering prices were quite high, I was expecting at least a good massage. Again big disappointment! First of all, no ambience, just a room with two leather seats and a tv while waiting. No Asian ambiance, no aromas, nothing. Massage room was also just a hotel room with two massage beds, direct and very bad lighting. Music was unstable and there was again nothing of a spa which normally gratifies all senses. Although the therapist was from Thailand, she was not very capable. I went there with a tensioned shoulder and ended up with headache.

We had lunch in the Ocean Restaurant which overlooks the ocean and has good ambience. Service was good, we were well attended. We had some sushi, which was really good. But the other food had nothing of a good restaurant. It was the thickest tempura batter I had seen in my life with prawn tempura! Also there is a rooftop bar which again has good ambience, but the music is so unnecessarily loud that we had difficulty sleeping even when we were on the 6th floor. Check out then was again very slow and no efficient coordination between departments to put a proper bill together. Because of missing or extra services on the bill, we had to go through the payment process twice. The only good thing I would say, they did not charge for that massage at the end. But I would have preferred to have a good spa treatment and pay rather...

The only thing that helped to have a happy Birthday evening was the amazing dinner we had in Sea Food Cove in Mount Lavinia Hotel! That made up for our disappointment with Kingsburry. I think Sea Food Cove is the best sea food restaurant in Colombo, open air – tables set on the sandy beach, ocean waves just around the corner, nice candle light, fresh and well prepared sea food and a very hospitable and efficient service! Price we paid was much lower than what we paid to the Ocean Restaurant in Kingsburry for lunch.

I would never go to Kingsburry Hotel again if not obliged. For business it can be tolerated maybe, but do not have much expectations from this place. Nothing is as it looks on the web site. For holiday and romantic getaway, I would recommend Mount Lavinia Hotel. Here rooms are not so great, but all the rest is so perfect and magical. For business Cinnamon Grand and Taj Samudra are perfect destinations!

management_response.text:
Dear gizemindia,

We assure you of our immediate attention in this regard and I reiterate our regrets.

title: Not as per expectation

title: Noisy hotel
text:
The hotel is of very poor noise insulation quality. You can hear the conversations in the next door rooms very clearly. In fact you can join the conversations of your next door guests. To add to this, the hotel hosts a lot of functions and allows them to play music until 4:50 am (the night I was there although I was promised that the function will finish at 3:30 am). 

When I complained, the manager did offer to move us to a room away from the noise. But what am I going to do with going to a smoking room (at 1am!) that is not connected to another room (as I have kids and I am booked for two connected rooms!). You can see this is not the first review that complains about noise. It is a very noisy hotel. 

The staff is warm and apologetic and did offer some discount due to the inconvenience. But that was the second night in a row that the hotel had functions until early in the morning and I was willing to pay double the price just to have a peaceful sleep (which I offered the hotel manager). 

What makes it worse, is they started cleaning up the party hall on the 10th floor at 7am and I could hear the vacuum cleaner/broom hitting the edges of the hall (which is three floors away!) which woke me up only after I managed to go to sleep at 5 am. 

The lobby gets very crowded and noisy due to the crowd attending the functions. It is not pleasant to sit in and have a peaceful cup of tea. 

Obviously I am not returning to this hotel.

management_response.text:
Dear Healthyplaces,

We are truly sorry despite all our efforts we have not managed to bring about any comfort to you during your stay. However, we are happy to bring to your attention this situation will be resolved to ensure a good night's sleep for all.

With warm regards and best wishes,
Dinithi

text: The hotel in general is good, the rooms are clean, and the lobby staff are friendly. However the Harbour Court restaurant is bad, the breakfast food is amazing but the dinner food is TOO spicy and they should know that not all people can handle spicy food. And the worst thing here in both breakfast and dinner is that when they come to my table is just take my plate without even asking if I'm done or not and if they ask they've already touched my plate.

title: Rooms are not sound proof.
text:
We stayed at the Kingsbury for three nights in August and probably won't stay there again. Front office staff and bellmen well trained and helpful. Dining room staff very professional and friendly.

title: Not so "High Tea"!
text:

We then served our plates and returned to our seats to eat only to be herded away to another table saying that was reserved. Food: The iced tea tasted horrible! Something in it certainly tasted disgusting and unhealthy! They had the same, very limited food presented in different areas and it certainly gave the initial impression of an extravagant spread. Food was stale and certainly a recycle from buffet!

I would not recommend this hotel.

title: Bad customer service. Risk of being stolen
text:
I'm not one of those who usually spend time writing bad reviews of places. I simply ignore them and decide not to go again. But, on that particular case, I think is worth sharing the experience. Some people might spend some money in what they expect would be a luxury urban experience in Colombo. 

We reach The Kingsbury on our final day of a meravelous Sinhalese journey through the Island. Local people is extremely kind and helpful when you travel around, so we got into the hotel, expecting a similar service.

Our experience:

Check in process was extremely slow. They couldn't find our booking. After some minutes, everyting aparently was fine.

The story could end up like a tiny anecdote, but things kept on happening.

In the process of check in you are required to leave your credit card in advance so that charges can be covered up automaticaly. It's a common practice in western countries but not in Sri Lanka.
Being the last day, we thought it would be ok paying in cash.... So we decline the offer. Half Board Service was already paid.

We reach the 8th floor and had a break on the room. At dinner time, we went down and discovered the elevator was out of order. If you have the chance to travel across the stairs, you will discover the "real" cleaningness of the backoffice areas. Several elderly people were strugling to hike up floors.

Food was regular, nothing impresive, and service in the restaurant extremely slow.

We got our bill at the end of the dinner and as we didn't leave the credit card in advance, we where required to go up (by foot) to the room and down again to take the money. That was after a comment like: "You have to pay your bills madam". Unfortunate words to a customer...
We were requesting formaly to pay at check out. But no affirmative response to a common sense request by a customer.

Again, everything could have been forgotten until today, at the airport, when we have discovered that all the cash from the wallet has been stolen. Every hotel would say you have a locker for that, but as we where preparing suitcases, we forgot some valuables on the table...

Remembering our steps, that happened at noon, when house keeping service entered to room to leave the Good Night Card.

We didn't had time to go back and present the claim at the front office. Probably tripadvisor, is a more effective way to explain our experience.

I hope that helps to people checking options in Colombo.

Cheers!

Laia

management_response.text:
Dear Laia T,

This is so unfortunate and what ever the circumstances were, we are sorry that you couldn't leave The Kingsbury and Sri Lanka on happy note. 

We must investigate this further. Please send us the name used at check-in to mgrccpr@thekingsburyhotel.com

We wish you well and assure that such matters will be taken up at the highest possible level.

With warm regards,
Dinithi

title: LOUD
text:
My husband booked 45 rooms here on business so we stayed here for about 17 days. Here is what I have to say: 
Service in all the restaurants is pathetic. You ask them for one thing and it takes them twenty minutes to get it. I had to ask four times to get a cup during breakfast. The 7th floor has a nagging garbage dump stench coming from the service exit door. It's so bad you think you're walking next to a garbage truck. The guests coming to attend the million weddings are so loud. Now, my final feedback is the noise. Coming from India, where hotels don't allow loud music after 10pm or at least if they do, you can't hear a peep in the rooms, Here, the marriage hall is on the 10th floor where the music is thumping and you can hear it on all the floors. It's awful! It's always so bloody loud. It's bad enough you have to hear the music from the pool side, add the sounds from the 10th floor and you're grabbing pillows to cover your ears. I've always stayed at the cinnamon grand when I come to Colombo and miss that! The housekeeping staff won't wait for more than two seconds after they ring the bell to open the door and walk in thinking no one is in the room. I finally had to tell the guy off as he rang the bell twice whilst I was in the loo and then opened the door and came
Into the room to ask if I wanted turn down service. Food isn't bad, but they need to have a bigger room service menu. Staff needs to be trained big time. For the most part they seem pretty uninterested in doing their jobs.

management_response.text:
Dear hmh1983,

We're extremely sorry to note your experience so far, since you're still staying with us I will meet up with you personally to look into all issues you have mentioned. 

Please do bear with us till then.

With warm regards,

title: Great hotel good location, very loud wedding
text:
This seaside hotel is situated very close to the historical part of Colombo so you can do everything by feet.
Good modern rooms with sea view and speedy Wifi.
the restaurant had large selection of food but in my opinion no super quality.
Friendly and helpful staff .
We had to complain a view times tho for the noisy wedding at the 10 floor, we stayed on the 9 floor. they finally stopped at 12.00 
A good 5 star hotel can not be this loud until 12 in the night inside the rooms.
Make some isolation or don't do wedding just above the rooms were people stay

Please do consider The Kingsbury again as we would be most privileged to have you stay with us.

With warm regards and best wishes,
Dinithi

title: Pleasant
text: Hotel was nice, especially lobby area and pool area. For a 5 star hotel rooms were comfortable but I've stayed in much nicer hotel rooms.  Elevators were always busy at the hotel which became a little annoying. Breakfast had a wide selection to choose from. Overall stay was pleasant enough.

management_response.text:
Dear qf11,

Thank you for your compliments and we're happy you've had a pleasant stay with us. We hope you have carried away good some good memories of Sri Lanka and The Kingsbury. 

We would be delighted to welcome you back and we wish you the very best.

With warm regards
Dinithi

title: Don't leave anything behind/ very slippery tiles at the pool area
text:
We stayed for 2 nights with our friends before we went up to Kandy.   Soon we left Kingsbury, our friends have found out they have left 3 jackets behind in the hotel.  Our tour guide has called the hotel and the hotel said they have found them.  We told them we will go back to Colombo on our last day to pick up the jackets.  

Guess what, when we went back to the hotel, the hotel said they cannot find them.
I don't really expect such things happened in luxury hotel.  And if it happened, the management should do/ say something about it.  But nothing happened.

The same thing happened in another hotel we stayed in Bentota.  But the manager there reacts promptly and gave a good apology.  That makes the difference.

Another thing to beware is the pool.  They have VERY slippery tiles around the pool.   Our kids have fallen few times but luckily they are ok.  But I can imagine someone may break their arm and kind of ruin their holidays.   Otherwise the pool is spacious and great to have an ocean view.

The rooms are clean,  nice ocean view.

The chinese restaurant is at very good standard. Authentic.  Walking distance to the Dutch Hospital.

management_response.text:
Dear ubesmart,

Please accept your sincere apologies in this regard however, we have not called off the search. Please provide me at mgrccpr@thekingsburyhotel.com the following information to track it down:
1. The name of the tour guide and his company name, a contact no for him if you have 
2 Your check-in name in full.

Your comments on the pool too have been noted and an anti-slip matt will be placed all around the pool.

We thank you for your patronage and the lovely compliments on the Chinese Restaurant - "Yue Chuan", rooms and the location. 

We look forward to welcoming you back to The Kingsbury!

With warm regards and best wishes,
Dinithi

title: A good experience
text:
We visited Colombo with some friends in 2013, most likely a lot would have been changed now over the past two years.

Back then, it was good. Front desk took a while though, to allocate our rooms . We were made to wait for almost an hour until we all "friends and family" were given our room keys.

Food (Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner) was really good - no complaints on that.
We found the rooms quiet clean but very small and cramped up with too many things put in one room, while for such a hotel it could have been a bit more spacious.
Room service / House keeping were all kind enough to serve us and support us in every way.

It was an okay experience, I'd say - not extremely good and not bad either!

P.S. I have mentioned my travel month and year as September 2014, as I cannot choose a month or year older than this. :)

management_response.text:
Dear Karina L,

We thank you for the compliments and your suggestions were noted too. With reference to your check-in experience, in the event there had been such a delay there should have been some form of compensation or an explanation give to you if the hotel had provided you with an early check-in on a complimentary basis.

Which ever the case may be, we are happy it was brought to our notice and will ensure our reception staff is adequately empowered to handle such situations.

We would be delighted to welcome you back, should you choose Colombo again.

With warm regards and best wishes,
Dinithi

title: Poor Service .. Not value for the money
text:
This was my second stay at the hotel and I was amused by the hotel interior and look of the hotel when I have stepped at the first time . However though I was not very impressed with my first stay in the hotel I have decided to stay at the second time during my recent holiday in Sri Lanka as I love the location and the food of Harbour restaurant . During my first stay at the hotel I found the room was not clean . Found some hair on bed linen as well as some stain on the night stand. Probably it was poured tea stains and forgot to clean . When I complained about the condition of the room that I have checked in ,  then bunch of room attendance came to the room and changed  the bed linen while I was in the room which is not acceptable at all . 

However I got to say that the hotel management tried their level best to comfort me to some extend during my first stay . This was the reason that I have decided to stay at the hotel after two years. 

But sadly I was fully disappointed during my recent stay about their service as it' was much bellow the five start standards . I was surprised to observe that few workmen were repairing the corridor ceiling right in front my room. I could not not walk out of the room as the corridor was full of construction materials . Whole place was packed of paint smell . I was shocked when I noticed  that. I was totally uncomfortable in the room and it is much bellow the five star standards. I have not experienced  in any part of the world that maintenance team carrying out the works while the guest in the room . I have further noticed that the complete floor was occupied . This much bellow the 5 start standards and it's purely due to lack of the hotel management . 

While I was in the rooms the door bell was rang twice consequentially by the staff . It was ago quick and short . I was changing my cloths . Before I open the door the staff opened the door and he said he need to check the mini bar . Guy was in a hurry  to complete his duty. This was not acceptable at all since I have signed him to not to open the door until I do so .

Most of the time I heard the loud conversations of rooms attendance in the coordinator while their at work and this has made me really uncomfortable . 

Additionally there was high flash light down on the lower roof of the hotel. When I inquire about this , they have further said that can not be switched of as it is focusing to the hotel logo which is on the higher roof . It's ashamed why they can't have proper lighting on the roof signage rather than having a big bulky flash light on the lower deck . This was really irritating me . 

I have found certain wall cracks and patches on the wall of the room that they have given to me . Attached few pics for reference. Rooms was not clean and tidy . Is this worth for the money that we pay ? Not at all 

However the money that I have paid is not fully worth for the service that I have got from the hotel . They need to improve their quality of service and I would not do the same mistake again  that I have done twice . Just posted some pictures bellow that I have taken to learn about the comfort that i have received while my stay at the hotel . I am fully disappointed of my stay

management_response.text:
Dear Prasanka E,

We've taken some time to look into the all the issues you have mentioned and found that we are at fault for giving you a room on this particular floor. The room attendants too have been addressed with regard to the noise levels in the corridors. 

Overall, we are sorry your experience has not been a satisfactory one. However, its our assurance that such maintenance work will not be carried out on occupied floors.

With warm regards and best wishes,
Dinithi

title: Never again think twice
text:
We as  14 people Stayed  3 nights and 4 days 
Location is excellent ideal place for morning walk galle face is just a min walk  prime location 
Reception work ok which was managed by our cox and king rep 

Coming to rooms - size is small as some reviewer mentioned no place between bed and the chair 
Bath room is good but no bath tub 
The old model TV is completely obsolete 
Complicated remotes 
We have to struggle with remotes 
Doesnot work properly even after complaing 
Not only in my room but in many rooms same problem 
TV programmes are very limited 
Don't get any proper tamil channels which is seen in many countries but not in SL in  spite of tamil here is national language - sounds odd 
Ac is excellent 
Buffet BF is good many option 
But the behaviour of staffs spoil all 
Is it  racism??  When we stand for egg appam which is a famous dish in SL naturally lot of crowd 
Only one guy that too in the L bent corner too difficult to stand there 
The sub staff started yelling to disperse to table. He showed his face saying that it will be supplied to table with sarcastic high tone voice 
Never expected in 5 star grade 
The irony is when we ask for something in table like water they say cooly no sir they cannot bring it 
Then how can  they bring appam and all 
 . My colleague was not happy with service during the dinner they had some argument .More disturbing happened next day morning
The same colleague called waiter to bring water which he said  can't 
When we called some manager like person don't u serve artleast water 
Then suddenly  they served water
But the waiter who refused water was laughing sarcastically and seen chatting with their colleague pasing comments on us . Being sinhala waiters passing comments and sarcastic laugh on people from india is just unaccrptable and it is blatant racism
14 people 9 rooms of five star hotels -- still misbehave 
And one more odd thing happened 
One of our colleague who came next day to join us  called from airport  saying so and so 14 people are staying in kingsbury and asked to connect to room 
To his shock telephone operator told no such people are staying 
Is it a 5 star service 
They don't even know who is staying in room ,

management_response.text:
Dear sivaortho,

We're happy you've enjoyed the breakfast buffet, central location of The Kingsbury giving you access to the Galle Face green along the beautiful sea side and the shopping & entertainment precinct across the road from the hotel. Thank you for the compliments.

However, we were saddened by your other comments and an inquiry was held that revealed a delay in service but we assure you that there is no prejudice against any nationality or race. The instance where your colleague had called the hotel asking to be connected to a room (in a party of 14 guests) could not be accommodated as they have not given a specific name, In this instance, its our policy to protect guest privacy, therefore unless the correct name is given its not possible for the operator to connect any calls. We hope you will appreciate this safeguard.

With regard to TV channels, please note we our Cable TV channels (over 50 channels) get the Indian and the Far East regions feed to Sri Lanka and unfortunately, the no of Tamil channels are limited. We have taken note of this and would incorporate more Tamil channels asap.

If your travels bring you back to Colombo It will be our privilege to welcome you back.

With warm regards and best wishes,
Dinithi

title: Awfully dated hotel
text:
This hotel really needs to step it up as between itself and the cinnamon it seems to have the monopoly on weddings and tourists.  The check in was a joke,  30 mins and I wasn't even told where the lifts were, what times breaks was on etc. These are some basic things you expect when you check in. One of the terminals were broken and while I was checking in ano the guest came and made a fuss about his room and they all fell at his feet so I was left waiting again. Lots of people on check in with no professionalism. 

Rooms were very small, basic and dated. Housing keeping guys are all fab as are the staff at the pool. Most of the staff speak very little English but do manage to communicate a little.

I personally wouldn't touch this hotel with a bargepole when you have somewhere like the cinnamon grand or lakeside which cost about the same and are far superior in every way.

This hotel will really need to step it up with so many other big chains like the marriott and inter contact opening soon.

I really feel that this place is like a cattle market and not a true refection of sri lankan hospitality.

management_response.text:
Dear Kay112,

Please accept our sincere apologies. We would like to investigate further into this unfortunate incident at check in, if you will not mind please send me your check-in name to mgrccpr@thekingsburyhotel.com.

If there is anyway we could compensate you, I will be in touch with you.

Warm regards and best wishes,
Dinithi

title: Great location and good rooms but average service
text: Rooms are badly planned. They are wide but not long. So the space between the end of the bed and the window / wall is literally a foot and a half. Bigger rooms are the same! Stayed in them too. They are just twice as wide but not longer than the smaller rooms! The room and bathroom were clean. The view was poor. Construction going on nearby. The food was good. The Chinese restaurant attached to the hotel is quite poor. Service was average. It's quite an old hotel but has been maintained well. They could do a lot better with the service and hospitality. With a couple of new hotels coming up close by, I'm not sure I would stay here again.

management_response.text:
Dear Totem_41_41,

We're sorry to note your experience and hope the fact that our room categories start at 252sq feet and go up to 504sq feet in the suites is of some comfort to anyone reading this. Our heavenly King size beds (except in twin rooms that come with single beds)  do take up space but they are in great demand as enjoyed by you and in giving us full marks for sleep quality. 

With regards to the Chinese restaurant and overall service comments, it would be most useful if you could let me know on mgrccpr@thekingsburyhotel.com the specific circumstances that led you this conclusion. We value your feedback, please be as frank as possible.

In the event you would change your mind about The Kingsbury, we would be delighted to have you stay with us.

With warm regards and best wishes,
Dinithi

title: OK experience but front desk need improvements good food.
text:
We reached there by our travel agent booking and we got rooms there. Our business partners are coming next day so we informed the front desk there are more rooms booked by our travel agent. They said will see later and finally we had to book our rooms in other hotels in Colombo. They did not give us the rooms even prior booking was done through the travel agent and they are not interested to check even we told the guest will be reaching early in the morning and we don't want them to wait in the reception. Finally we had to come down to reception to talk with guest and request to the front office staff in early morning. They said we don't get confirmation from travel agent. What we should understand by this???
Previous day itself we clearly told them to clarify with the travel agent for this booking and don't need any hassle in check in. But I am sorry they have not done any initiative to confirm the booking. 

Management have to seriously look forward to this issue otherwise seriously affect to  hotel reputation. In future days Colombo is growing up well because tourism industry is introducing many projects and we are bringing lot of clients to Srilanka for tourism.

Kingsbury is not only the hotel have the same problem with reservation system but still I am bringing in to the notice of all the travellers and management notice to improvements.
Looking forward to see improvements in future visits and I am a frequent traveller to Colombo at least once in a month.
Restaurant was good and staffs are polite and helpful.
Appreciated the chef and team to make our food delicious.
Cheers...

management_response.text:

Thank you for taking the time to bring this our notice, we have taken serious note of it. We hope to see you again soon and next time your reservation is made through a travel agent, please do insist on getting a confirmation to your hand.

Dinithi

title: Small room for big money
text:
Right at the ocean.  Our room was quite small. Room service was slow or didn't come at all. They are was a lot of construction going on next to the hotel so the view won't be that great anymore in the future. 
But

The buffet  was the best i had on the whole trip.  Just amazing. So that worth the stay alone.

Thank you for the feedback as well as the compliments. We do regret the fact that there is a Port City construction across the road from the hotel. But, fortunately for Sri Lanka, the country is developing at a fast pace and such hindrances are to be expected in a growth period.
