title: 1 Star to get attention, for someone to care.
text:
I'm writing this review, and giving 1 star to hopefully get the hotels attention. There were many great things about this hotel, but some truly unacceptable, deplorable issues that occurred.

Upon first arrival you are greeted by bellmen and bell staff who do a fantastic job of greeting you and collecting your bags. The check in process was smooth and efficient and we were even walked up to our room by a front desk manager, showing us all aspects of the hotel and our room. This is where the management service and quality stopped, abruptly. 

We quickly changed into our bathing suits and headed down to the pool, it had been too many hours in the car for our daughter and she needed out. Upon entering the pool you notice odd double sized stairs that are awkward to walk up and down. Upon further review I realized that these are an architectural design to fill with flower pots, there are other normal stairs around the same area; the hotel has apparently not chosen to maintain the flowers. I watched as one guest misjudged the steps and almost fell down them. The entire pool area is surrounded in polished stone, marble? This is a horrible idea near a pool, the smoothest surface one can imagine in a wet area made for a couple of slips and near falls by me and my daughter full out falling three times, luckily none serious. Finding a chair to sit in we ordered drinks and appetizers. Quickly upon receiving our drinks we noticed a lot of ants and decided to move as we saw an old dropped ice cream and cone behind the table. We explained this to the staff, but no one ever went to the table to see or clean while we were in the area, as I left much later it was still there. Once our food arrived the ants were the least of our problems, Crows began attacking to get our food, fighting them off we looked to the pool staff to assist us in moving or shooing away the birds and they simply stood around watching us. Only after my wife had to walk up to them and yell at them did they assist in any way, holding our food behind the bar while we were away from the table. 

And this is the issue, not so much the wait staff, but the management. During all of these pool events, ants, birds, slips, stumbles and falls, there were three to four managers (I Assume based on their outfits) all in a glassed in room overlooking the pool area. They were all sitting around a computer doing something, YouTube, Training, Inventory, something; but they were also looking out at the events talking to each other, but doing nothing about any situation. I have worked for years in all types of the hospitality industry, Restaurants, Hotels, Management, Staff, etc... And I can tell you that as a manager who sees guests get up and move tables, you ask why. Seeing guests fighting with birds and no staff assisting you ask why, seeing guests slip, stumble, fall you immediately assist, whatever your department. You also remember that "Perception is Reality" and when guests see you and perceive you to be doing nothing that is their reality. To me it looked like a bunch of guys hanging out watching online videos. As I Said they may have been doing real work, but being in view of the guests they should be working for the guests. My wife wanted me to confront them there, but knowing that four of them would all stand together and not care or take any action I felt it would be best to wait for checkout and the standard "How was your stay?" and then I could discuss it separate from the event. That question was never asked, there was no concern for how my stay was or how my experience was, simply, pay your bill and have a nice day. I have had other reviews on trip advisor where I explain my bad experiences, but mention how management discussed the situation and is looking into it. Not here.
My experience is that the managers are more interested in being managers, having the title, walking around in a suit and shaking hands. They are not interested in hospitality or guest service, they are interested in themselves. Except the first manager he seemed to be genuinely interested in showing us the hotel.
The rooms were nice and comfortable, a bit small though. The lobby was busy with tourists having tea so it felt like a bus terminal.
I am sure many others will stay here and have a fantastic experience and rave about the hotel, I probably would have too if I hadn't gone to the pool, saw and experienced what I did, and watched staff sit around. I can not recommend this hotel to anyone based on my experience though.

title: worst hotel in Colombo!
text: The worst service ever!..the worst staff ever!.rooms are so dirty..not like what it shows in there website at all..was the worst experience ever,not worth the money at all..not the best place to be if your looking to stay in colombo..was there a week and it was soooo terrible!!.

title: Extremelly Disappointed, will not recommend
text:
We stayed at the Suite room 710, The website claims
"With breathtaking views of the ocean and the lush expanse of the Galle Face Green, and bathrooms equipped with a Jacuzzi overlooking the sea" actually the room did not have the lush expanse of the Galle face green and the bathroom was not overlooking the sea.
The website states" Daily Bowl of Fruits & Chocolates
International newspapers & magazines" but there was none of these, when I checked with the reception they said they will send immediately but even after complaining to the manager it took more than 1 hr to receive the so called Bowl of Fruits & Chocolates I was shocked to see a plate with a few Sri Lankan sweets and one green apple. The shower cubicle was too small and  door opens inwards and you have to step away so that you don't get knocked off by the door as you open it. The morning buffet was another big disappointment the dishes were barely filled, most of the chaffing dishes were empty and they did not bother to refill even when requested, the egg station had a Que with more than 10 guest waiting and it took 1/2 an hour to get my egg omelet, hoppers I had to forgo because there was no way of getting one due to the crowd, the auto closing lids of the chaffing dishes kept closing before we could pick up the food, it needs to be repaired, the staff in the restaurant were very rude.

Conclusion: misleading web site information, bad service, rude staff, worst dining experience.

title: Just OK
text:
I am a regular traveller to Sri Lanka and choose to stay at this hotel for 3 nights, with a tour group. Check in was smooth as we arrived about 2:00am.  Room are nice, small and a little claustrophobic but the king size bed was very comfortable.  Bathroom is tiny and not much room to put your stuff, but a lovely rain shower.  TV control. Is a nightmare and very difficult to negotiate, they have a frame around the tv and I don't know wether this impedes the effectiveness of using the control.  I did talk to others in my party and they also complained about this.  Breakfast is ok, with a satisfactory assortment, but the service is not up to standard.  Had to ask for tea and coffee three times, before a cup was placed in front of me.  Only one cup, even though all six on the table had asked for coffee/tea.  The foyer of this hotel is impressive, but the staff do not seem happy, not friendly at all.  We spent the day at the pool, very big and impressive pool, limited shade and very exposed area.  Service in this area not to bad, however encountered a very big overcharging problem and a manager then refunded a very large sum of money to our party.  Not good at all.
We also witnessed an argument in front of guests of the bar boys.  No manager on sight to sort them out.  In room bar fridges were locked and at no time was it explained at check in the they require a fee to open them.  Charges to room, at the start of our stay were not allowed, cash only.  We then spoke to management to work this out but it took two attempts for this to be cleared up.
Skybar is a good venue and very enjoyable, spectacular view.
Overall this hotel has a long way to go . Overall friendliness of staff needs considerable in house training to match up to other hotels In the near vicinity.   Not sure if I would bring another tour group here?

title: Nothing Special
text:
This is my first time in Sri Lanka (work/play).  I had researched and read a couple of reviews when trying to choose a hotel and i found this one tick most of the boxes.

On our arrival at the Kingsbury Hotel i was pleasantly surprised as i was not expecting the lobby or service to be what they had portrayed in the pictures on their website, but that is exactly what it is like.  Polite and helpful staff at the check in desk. We had a hiccup on check in (not their fault) but they were very accommodating, they took us to a room in which we could refresh and wait until the room we had actually booked was ready for us.  Dylan, one of the floor managers at the hotel, was especially helpful.  Nothing was too much for him. Ask for him. Very competent.

The rooms; I had booked room 601 this is a double suit room.  the bed is facing the ocean, with uninterrupted views! Absolutely amazing.  The beds are comfortable, the TV was a samsung flat screen and they had a good selection of channels and an even better selection of movies.  
On our first night, we had experienced the thumping lots of previous Kingsbury Hotel guests complained about, but because of you guys and your reviews we were sure not to take a room underneath the SkyBar.  Our room was on the 6th floor on the other side and the noise was minimal.  My husband is a light sleeper and he knocked out, which says a lot lol.

The food, I myself am not a big curry fan, so yeah probably in the wrong country! hahaha...I didn't suffer, great choice of international food at the hotel, if you don't like their food you could always go to the neighbouring hotels and grab something there, the Hilton is literally a hop skip and jump away.

The Laundry service; very attentive, in fact i got two separate phone calls and a room visit from the laundry service to double check on certain pieces of clothing! Didn't get that service at the Burj Al Arab!

The Spa, DO NOT GO FOR A FACIAL, its not what you think it is.  My friend went for a facial and was very upset.  She said they had used baby oil on her face after she had specifically asked her therapist not to!
I had an Aromatherapy massage, not great but it helped with the muscle tension.

You must do the city tour, ok, it won't change your life but its a nice trip around and if you have a good guide you'll learn quite a lot about he history of the country...etc. You will finish Colombo in one day.
Your guide, if organised by the hotel will promise to take you to the "best of the best" I am a Gemologist and the places he took us for Gems, was not worth it at all, especially for the price they were asking!  Be sure to ask for a guide from the GEM ASSOCIATION to go with you! you'll find them in the Trade Centre. If for whatever reason you are unable to do that don't buy the gem until you get it authenticated at the Trade Centre, its a free service and only after you get a certificate of authenticity should you go a head and buy it.  When you get back to your country get it tested again! just incase.

In general, it was a good trip and hopefully next time i will get the chance to experience some other parts of Sri Lanka.

PS. check local festivities before booking Sri Lanka, we unfortunately, came on their new year and basically nothing was open! 

In short i would stay at this hotel :)

title: Beautiful hotel but appalling service
text:
We stayed at The Kingsbury Hotel for one night before departing back home.

The location of the hotel is beautiful. We managed to get a partial ocean view room which overlooked the Indian ocean. Try to get a room from 5th floor above to enjoy the views more.

The hotel itself is very beautiful and clean and maintained to a high standard. The skylounge on the top floor had great views with a good DJ.

However, upon arrival we did not even receive a welcome drink, after staying in various other hotels in Sri Lanka, this was very disappointing for a 5* hotel. 

The service was very poor at dinner and breakfast. We asked for some tea and ketchup for breakfast and it took them half hour to get it to us. Instead the staff did other things and ignored our request. There was no variety of vegetarian food at dinner even after trying to speak to the chef they barely paid us any attention, which was very upsetting as you would expect more from a 5* hotel.

When trying to check out of the hotel, we called the concierge to pick up our bags from the hotel rooms. However after many phone calls later, it was only until our driver told the concierge to get our bags that somebody came up to our room. By that point we got so fed up of waiting that we decided to take our bags ourself back to the lobby. If we had waited for the concierge to pick up our bags, we probably would have missed our flight. Even when complaining to the reception desk, they were not willing to listen or show an ounce of care to the guests.

I would definitely not recommend this hotel to anyone who is looking for amazing service as you will definitely not find it at this hotel, which is meant to be "5*".

title: Abysmal Service
text: We were at the hotel for dinner and the wait staff did everything wrong and when we asked the manager to correct things even he could not get it right.  Considering that you are paying prices equivalent to those in the US, I expected better service.  Utterly disappointed.  They took over 30 minutes to get us drinks! Got the order for the kids absolutely wrong.  Did not not have enough place settings or cutlery on the table for the number of guests.   These can all be fixed with better training of the otherwise inexperienced staff and management.  The hotel which has been a well known establishment in Colombo for many years is still beautiful, and the location by the ocean cant be beat.

title: Never again
text:
Thankfully we only stayed one night at the end of our months trip around Sri Lanka. The first thing was on arrival to our room, making a cup of tea, the kettles handle was broken, so we were unable to use. We reported the fault and went out. On return we put the kettle on, when I tried to pick it up the handle came away from the kettle!! Could have been very dangerous. They did then come with a replacement. 
The second issue was a party that started around 7pm that had extremely loud "boom boom" music that we could hear in our room. By 10pm it had got unbearable, so we were moved to another room. 
The party was on the top floor, we were on 7th floor! 
I appreciate the management tried help us to overcome the problem of the loud music, but I would think that they should have a policy in place to insure guests are not disturbed by functions that are obviously held regularly at the weekend. 
We ate breakfast and lunch, both buffet style, but we were very unhappy with the quality of food. 
We would not stay here again.

title: A Lovely Stay Spoiled
text:
We were booked into The Kingsbury as "the best hotel in Colombo". From checking in to dinner, everything went very well.We were upgraded to the Executive floor (9) and had a lovely room with a view over the harbour. At the moment there is a major land reclamation and refurbishment programme being carried out along the front, so the view was impaired by vehicles and materials. That was not a problem. We chose to eat in The Ocean dining room and the seafood was excellent and priced appropriately for this quality of hotel. The staff on the executive floor were first rate, helpful and friendly.
As we had to leave early (5.30 a.m.) to catch a flight to Cochin, we arranged for a packed breakfast, which once again was excellent. The problems started when retiring at about 10.30 p.m. We seemed to be right under the function room and were bombarded by heavy beat music. Expecting it to finish reasonably early at around 11.00 - 12.00, we didn't bother to complain, as we had to be up at 4.30 and by the time we had changed rooms and moved all our things, it would have been midnight. On reflection, we should have complained immediately. It finally ceased about 2.30 a.m. About half an hour later there was hammering on the ceiling. So we got up and got ready to leave. When checking out we received what I consider to be an inadequate apology and the explanation that the contractors were preparing for the next function and that the hotel had no control over what time they started! A very unwelcome end to what was a potentially delightful stay.

management_response.text:
Dear Guest,

We are very sorry to note your stay at The Kingsbury was spoilt due to noise. Please give us an opportunity to make it up to you on your next visit to Sri Lanka.  

I would personally attend to this, kindly mail me your next visit's details to mgrccpr@thekingsburyhotel.com

Thank you and yours sincerely,
Dinithi Somaratne

title: Dinner. What dinner?
text:
3 friends and I decided to eat in the Chinese restaurant. We waited 90 minutes for the 1st course to arrive - which it finally did after we had to main course delivered. the drinks were delivered 1 at a time and one was not delivered at all. (When I asked where my drink was the restaurant manager also laughed in my face) The food was cold when it arrived with the rice arriving first and being served and then nothing else. No vegetables were delivered despite being ordered Nobody was prepared to listed to our complaints. Oh, and a waiter wiped his dripping nose on his hand and proceeded to the kitchen. 
I have never, never, never experienced such appalling service from what is supposed to be a 5 star hotel. Frankly I wouldn't give this restaurant and the service from the hotel management even 1 star. I'm supposed to attend a wedding reception there this week but I will NEVER set foot in this hotel again in my life. 
I have reviewed many hotels and restaurants in this beautiful country and always tried to give an honest opinion of every part of my dining experience but I cannot find one redeeming thing to say about this restaurant.

title: Not 5-stars considering the service
text:
I will start with the two positive points: Location and the Ocean Restaurant with perfect food and service.

For the rest I was disappointed. It's not really a 5 star hotel considering the service level, just 3 examples from my 1-night stay: 

- when I came in the pool bar I ordered a beer and pineapple juice, after ca 25 minutes I asked why it takes so long, the reply was that in 5 minutes I would be served, after another 10 minutes I asked again and it appeared that they don't have the beer I ordered so they are looking for it (in another hotel bar or sth like that) and they asked me if I want another beer, finally I was served...

 - according to the website, in the deluxe rooms there should be "Chocolate/fruit bowl with a variety of tropical fruits on arrival". As it was not there Iasked for it in the reception, after more than 1 hour I had to ask again and finally after another 45 minutes it was brought - well the variety of tropical fruit appeared to be two apples, 5 grapes and one strawberry, exotic and varied indeed and where was the chocolate?

 - on leaving I asked the reception for someone to help me with my luggage, after 15 min I decided not to waste my time and took the luggage down myself 

The remote control worked only if the distance to the TV was not more than 1,5m Conclusion: If you want real 5 stars go to Cinnamon Grand

title: "YUE CHUAN" Restaurant at the Kingsbury
text:
Experience at this hotel has never been pleasant , i first visited this place after it was refurbished in 2013 and that too was for lunch at their habour room and it was a complete night mare, so i wrote to the management (to which i never received any sort of reply) and never sighted the place again. subsequently i ended helping one of my friends do a wedding their and that too didn't go too to well , overall it had many negatives in my mind However yesterday my wife decided to visit this place as they had some exciting offers going on in some of their restaurants, hence we made a reservation at the "Yue Chuan" Restaurant for lunch.
Even though i was extremely skeptical , i finally agreed to go back ,
The Restaurant overall  , has a very cosy ambiance and goes well with the cuisine they serve , staff was very friendly. and there wouldn't have been more that 3 groups at any given time to service , hence service was good. Been to many restaurants in leading hotels in sri lanka my expectations was to have a "wow" meal , so with that in mind we placed our order , we had one appetizer ( to save up for the mains) . We ordered a salty chicken for the appetizer it was ok , however a lot of improvement is needed , firstly the cuts were bad , so my wife ended up just eating too pieces as it didn't look very tempting to her, The meal; overall was ok , we had a lamb and pork dish which was good and nothing spectacular. the rice was ok , no significant flavor  per se , so in summary it was an average meal ,it could be argued that my previous experience could have blurred my expectations , but in simple for the price i paid which was including a significant discount , it was some what comforting , but arguably you could spend the same amount and enjoy a similar or even in some cases a better meal at any one of the restaurant ( not in any hotels i.e) around Colombo. So the final question : " would i go there again " Answer : "No" , but the most exciting fact for us is that the desserts were heavenly , had a black and white chocolate mousse and man didn't it rock ! . So to rephrase " would i go there for again for anything sugary and sweet" Answer : " Hell yeah !"

title: Luxury hotel with poor service
text: This is a very swanky hotel in the centre of Colombo overlooking the Indian Ocean. Very high standard rooms and excellent communal facilities including a large outdoor pool, and rooftop cocktail lounge. Unfortunately the service is poor, there appears to be a shortage of staff, but an excess of managers/supervisors who do not effectively direct their staff or engage with visitors. In the buffet style restaurant used plates were not cleared away in a timely manner, we struggled to be served with coffee, and when I asked to sign the bill a restaurant manager ignored me. At checkout the next morning three requests to collect luggage from the rooms were ignored despite appropriate staff being available. Senior management need to get a grip.

title: As business hotel: all looks, no substance
text:
I stayed in the Kingsbury 3 days during a business trip to Colombo in Feb 2014. The hotel looks very nice with its colonial style, but for business that's it, nothing beyond the looks.
The lobby is always crowded with loads of tourists. If you want to have a conversation with business partners, you better go somewhere else, because between the noise caused by the tourists and the loud music, there's no way to hold a conversation.
The rooms are clean and well furnished but very small, even at club floor where I was staying. There's only a small desk with a nice looking but uncomfortable chair, not exactly conducive for relaxed work. The desk has only 1 single power plug.. if you need to charge your computer and phone(s) at the same time, go and find another plug around the room. The worst of all is the internet.. free for the club floor (I'm not sure if it's free for other rooms) but absolutely useless!!! because the speed sucks! I've stayed at other hotels in Colombo where the speed was 1-2Mb (free connection), so it's not a problem with internet in Colombo but with the Kingsbury. Because of that, I couldn't work at all while at the hotel during my stay.
The 'club'.. well the club is just pathetic.
It opens for breakfast with the standard fare for a club floor, nothing to complaint about that. The problem is that breakfast aside it only offers a extremely limited assortment  of snacks and drinks during 2 hours in the evening. There are other hotels in Colombo with snacks and non-alcoholic drinks all day around.
The breakfast downstairs has a huge selection, but the quality is not that good and service really sucks. Regional dishes are watered and lack flavour. Maybe made so to cater for a tourist crowd not used to spicy flavours.. As for the service: day one, ordered coffee and it took 20min to arrive.. Day 2, it never came.
On the day of checkout, my colleagues and I were in a rush, so before going upstairs to change and finish packing we told reception to prepare our bill. When we came down 30min later, the bill was not ready and we had to wait 15min.
In summary.. if you are staying as a tourist, the Kingsbury should be fine, but if you go on business to Colombo, stay somewhere else as I will do in my next trip.

title: AVOID, SNOBBY, HORROR STORY, SCARED
text:
AVOID AVOID AVOID! Two young girls, we came from staying at the Heritance Ahungalla hotel where the service and staff were impeccable almost to the point where they made you feel like an extended family they would do everything in there power ensure that your stay was comfortable. NOT at The Kingsbury. If you are not from Sri Lankian they treat you like you are dirt, way too many black jacketed middle managers milling around being busy-bodies. 

THE HORROR STORY- We arrived back to our room after a day at the pool to find my wedges had been ripped apart from the soles and tampered with. Upon informing managers all five of them came up to our room all guns blazing! HIGHLY INTIMIDATING with security only to blame us and not there staff, My question why would a staff member do that? We felt unsafe and they informed us that there staff wouldn't do that! BLAMING THE CUSTOMER. They refused to pay me to fix my shoes instead was rude and laughed the matter off! they claimed that they would get my shoes fixed  when in fact all they did was super glue them together! In the morning when finally checking out as walking to the lift the house keeper apologised to me for breaking my shoes! AND THEY TOLD US THAT THERE STAFF DON'T DO THINGS LIKE THAT! security made us empty our suitcases as we felt scared in case staff tried to fill my shoes with drugs. This was the worse experience of my life. For two young girls to experience what we wen't through is unforgivable.

POSITIVES Room was very good, the pool area fine for a city hotel, and The Ocean food delicious. The SkyLounge is a world-class location, and perfect for sundowners. The Pool staff are the only people who are not snobby!

title: Highly Disappointed With the Kingsbury Hotel in Colombo
text: The Kingsbury was to be a treat, our last two nights in Sri Lanka.OMG,my daughter and I were left waiting in the Lobby for an hour,after a long hot drive from Kandy.We were then told the room I had booked and paid for Six weeks prior would not be ready until 6pm,they tried to offer another room which on site we refused.The staff were very busy fawing over Bridal parties, and Saudi clients.After me becoming really annoyed, magic they found us our room.This all took 2 hours.Yes the room was small, the view not at all nice,and not what I requested.We went out for dinner.The next morning at 9.20 we went for breakfast,and I was greeted with " we close at 10am ",charming greeting.The staff swaned about with an air of aloofness,and were very snobby.At approx 11am  we realised our fridge was broken, we informed them and went out for the day, on our return at 4.30pm.no cold drinks,no new fridge, 4 calls to the lobby later,and a lot of annoyance we got a fridge at 7pm.I forfieted that second nights payment and happily Wwent back to the Ramada,where we spnt our first night,they were thrilled to have us back, and said they got many complaints re The Kingsbury.They have an over rated opinion of them selves.and on checking out there was no asking why ?.Just let you all know we stayed at Decco on 44,Cinnamon Cital,Hotel Sigiriya,Hotel Elephant Bay, to name a few, and they were all stunning,beautiful staff.But the Ramada saved us.They did not get the fact that I am part Srilankian,my Australian accent threw them, We are an easy going, relaxed pair of Aussies,and  loved every minute of Sri.But that experience was utter rubbish,Go the Ramada. My name is Ms McNaughton,just in case the Kingsbury are reading this,pick up your game.

title: Good in parts
text: Very modern, extremely clean and truly excellent fish restaurant. The hotel lacks atmosphere and the service ( even for a couple who have been visiting and working in Sri Lanka for nearly 15 years) was so slow that we wondered if we had simply been forgotten. The room was very comfortable

management_response.text:
Dear Guest,

Greetings from The Kingsbury!

Firstly, I wish to thank you for choosing The Kingsbury for your stay. I am pleased that you enjoyed The Ocean, our seafood restaurant, the luxury outlook of the hotel and the comforts of our rooms. 

Your feedback is of great importance to us and your concerns regarding the service of our staff will be regarded as priority in the generation of the hotels' services. 

Thank you for sharing your feedback here on Trip Advisor. My team and I hope you will visit us again in the near future as we look forward to welcoming you back to The Kingsbury.

Rest assured, your next visit to the hotel will be a whole new experience! 

Best regards,

Sunil Dissanayake.

title: Mixed bag of good and bad
text:
We were in Colombo for our good friend's wedding in December-January and were suitably impressed with the photos on the hotel website.

The Good:
Excellent location--right next to commercial and historic heart of Colombo.  Stunning sea views.  Very clean, cozy, elegant room.  Some reviewers have remarked that the rooms are on the small side, but they were just right for us.  Lovely public spaces (pool, lobby, restaurants).  When we requested a room change, they immediately accommodated us.

The Bad:
Reservations staff did not respond to my email inquiries after I had made the booking.  A kind PR lady who came across my email responded to me and forwarded my message to the department concerned, but no reply still.  While checked in, when I called to ask about my total bill, the person on the line gave me a price completely different from what my booking indicated.  I had to go down and talk to the front desk to straighten out the matter, but they didn't have any idea who could have given me the wrong info.  Left my cellphone charger in the initial room they had booked us into (smoking, because the hotel was full).  Customer service promised to have the charger delivered to me by 7 am and by 9 am I still didn't have it, despite a few follow-up calls.  Housekeeping apologized as they said they were very busy at that time.  Upon checkout, I found a telephone charge on my bill despite not having made any calls at all.  Since it was only a small amount, I did not argue anymore and just paid for it it.  

Hope they can remedy these little issues on the service front as they do add up to a bit of stress on what was otherwise a very nice stay, thanks in great part to the kindness and warmth of Sri Lankan hospitality.  I am very much looking forward to going back to and seeing more of this amazing country.

management_response.text:
Dear Guest,

Greetings from The Kingsbury!

Thank you very much for choosing The Kingsbury for your stay during your visit to Sri Lanka. Thank you for your appreciation towards the kind hospitality of Sri Lankans, which indeed makes me proud to say that I am a Sri Lankan. 

It is the little things that always matter in the hospitality industry and it upsets me that such little things caused you inconveniences during your stay. I apologize whole heartedly and assure you that these matters will be looked into and rectified immediately in order to provide all our guests with the best luxury experience at The Kingsbury. 

Thank you for sharing your feedback with the Trip Advisor community. We hope you will visit The Kingsbury when you visit Sri Lanka again as we look forward to welcoming you back, not just once, but many a times more. 

Warm regards,

Sunil Dissanayake.

title: Warning- You will not get a good night sleep here!
text: The hotel has a function venue on the top floor- meaning any rooms from floor four to nine will not get sleep until 11:30pm! We had an early flight out- meaning we wanted to be sleeping by 10pm, music went on until 11:30pm! It is LOUD and one cannot sleep. After complaining to front desk a very rude and incompetent Manager- Mr Adman- told us that they have a license to go on until midnight and that if we didn't like it- tough. He never offered to move us or even a basic apology. Don't stay here- you will not sleep and the Manager/staff attitude towards its guests is a big disappointment to an otherwise good hotel. Stay somewhere else!

management_response.text:
Dear Guest,

Greetings from The Kingsbury!

Firstly, I wish to thank you for choosing The Kingsbury for your stay during your visit to Sri Lanka.

Secondly, please accept my humble apology for the inconvenience you experienced due to the noise disturbance and the response you received regarding it. Service is something we pride ourselves on and something that we do not compromise nor take lightly, therefore your comments have been well noted, and changes will be made wherever necessary and possible.

We hope to see you again at The Kingsbury.

Best regards,

Sunil Dissanayake

title: Poor service & cockroaches!
text:
Stayed here for a few days in January 2014 with friends and had to wait over 30 minutes after check in time as my room was not ready & did not even receive an apology. This was after arguing for 10 minutes as to which type of room I booked & having to prove it. Also they needed to check if payment has been made, surely they should do this before guests arrive.

Saw 3 cockroaches in the bathroom over a few days we stayed, when staying at what is meant to be a 5 star hotel this should not be the case. 

My advice is stay at some of the other 5 star hotels surrounding this one...this place is not worth it.

management_response.text:
Dear Guest,

Greetings from The Kingsbury!

Thank you for taking the time to review your stay at The Kingsbury.

On behalf of my team, I sincerely apologies for the inconveniences you experienced during your stay. We have taken serious note of your comments, and will genuinely look into the same and change where ever possible and necessary, in order to ensure that your next stay with us will be refreshing, exciting and an overall wonderful experience.

Warm regards,

Sunil Dissanayake.

title: Poor rude staff and small rooms- stay elsewhere
text:
I was looking forward to staying at this hotel and unfortunately it did not turn out very well. 

The upgrade which was the reason we booked this hotel was not offered, checkin was very slow, staff were not at all friendly, and when I spoke to a manager about this she did not seem particularly interested. 

This hotel says it is five stars however in my opinion more like barely 3. The elevators are also very crowded with non-residents as there is a rooftop bar that not only crowds the elevators and has people who seem to have a lot to drink wandering around but also has loud music that will keep you up until at least midnight every night (it is very loud with a band and a dj). 

The roof top lounge is beautiful however on the day I was there the staff were very slow (even with 12 servers working it took 25 minutes just to get a menu) and then due to an error the checkin made they told me I would have to pay cash and not sign to my room and treated me almost as a thief. When I complained to the manager he did not even care. 

Do not stay here this hotel is really very poor for service and rooms are tiny.

title: Beautiful Hotel but still needs some work
text: The hotel its self is beautiful the rooms a very small we had to get a Premium Room to have enough space for us with the two little ones. Buffet breakfast was great pool is beautiful however it does look out onto a construction site across the road and next door to the hotel. The biggest problem we had here was the communication problem with the staff the do not seem to understand English very well which became very annoying. We also found the Chinese restaurant down stairs to be very overpriced and did not enjoy the food we sent back a chicken dish because it was stone cold from the fridge and instead of cooking us a fresh dish they just reheated the same chicken .

title: A shockingly awful hotel
text: We arrived on an overnight flight from London to check into our pre-booked suite. I was asked to take the room key of a Mr Francois Chitewel (even though my name is Mrs Joanna Francis),  and assured it was a simple spelling mistake. Well, we felt sorry for Mr Chitewel as his room looked out onto a concrete roof, had a door that wouldn't close and badly chipped furniture. On complaining it took 4 members of staff to work out I wasn't Mr Chitewel and to find us our suite. On entering the room (which did have a nice coastal view) the first thing we could hear was thumping loud music. On questionning (which took 4 calls to speak to someone who could help us) we were told it was a party that would finish by midnight - given we had just got off a long haul flight we were not at all satisfied with that. So onto our 3rd room, a suite on a lower floor, and finally 2 hours after getting to the hotel we were finally checked in. We also got a unrequested 5am wake up call! Great! Utterly classless hotel with a quantity over quality approach to staffing. A horrible introduction to a country we fell in love with over the next 2 weeks. AVOID.

title: The worst hotel I have ever been
text:
New Year Eve dinner: awfull organitzation. We got no chance to change from the first seating to the second, when afterwards extra tables were included into the restaurant. The only solution given from the hotel was to have a seat in the contiguous hall outside the restaurant.

Swimming pool New Year Eve party: It was impossible to sleep until 6.30 a.m for the private party organised in the swimming pool of the hotel. We should have to call to the reception several times to find a solution but we are still waiting for it.
How a hotel with this category allows this kind of parties that do not let their guests sleep during the whole night without giving any solution from the hotel.

title: Nice hotel but Female Lobby Manager rude
text: We stayed at the Kingsbury in December and found he hotel & staff excellent, however on return in January, we found the Lobby Manager Ms. Vajiza to be extremely rude and arrogant. She definitely needs training in customer service. We were advised by others to stay at the Cinnamon Grand & will certainly be staying there in the future & recommending the same to our friends.

title: Quite possibly the worst customer service and satisfaction from a hotel I have ever stayed in.
text: Whilst the hotel is clean and extremely busy (seems to be popular with local weddings) we were placed on the 6th floor right beneath the sky bar (and a smoking floor which we never requested)The music blared thru our room till 3am each night. After repeatedly phoning the management, and complaining to staff 4 nights later, we were moved 4 doors down on the same floor. The management clearly don't care about their guests satisfaction. No one bothered to return any of our calls of complaint, and it took a rather heated argument in the lobby with onlookers for any action to finally take place. I would definitely NOT recommend  this hotel to anyone coming to Columbo, in particular if you enjoy a restful nights sleep.

title: Its okay but ...
text:
The Kingsbury is a former Inter-Continental Hotel and looks the part.  Rooms are quite good although rooms on lower levels at the rear of the hotel overlooking the carpark and generator are worth avoiding.
The bar on the top floor is well worth a visit and a cocktail to take in the city and ocean views.
The buffet breakfast is great if you can get it wrapped into your room tariff with a nice selection of western and Sri Lankan fare and good views across the water.  It’s worth asking for a coffee from the espresso bar which seems to cost nothing extra and is vastly superior.
Well located in the Fort district with the Galle Face Green area a nice (10 to 15 minute) waterfront walk away.
Gym and pool are nice and well maintained.
Note – Major excavation works were happening when we were at the hotel to create an extension for the race track circuit.  Currently the race is only once a year but unclear what the works will do in terms of ongoing noise and access to the waterfront.

title: Bad start
text: After travelling for 24 hours and to arrive at the hotel at 2 30 am and be told you room is not ready is exceptionally poor and unforgivable in any standards. The rest of the stay was nothing exceptional, the staff and food were pleasant however checking out seemed to take an eternity. I am sure there would be something better in Colombo.

title: Let down by poor service
text:
This hotel seems to believe that quantity of staff on hand will somehow equate to quality. It took us 15 minutes to clear check in and we still did not receive the twin bed room we requested months ago.
We tried the dining room at 6.30 and at that time it was practically deserted but the manager insisted it was fully booked and allocated us a spot to eat opposite the lift foyer. Later his colleague came up and couldn't believe where we had been seated. The food was fairly average and by the time we left the room was still almost empty.
Various other instances happened during our stay which showed a lack of staff training and attention to detail.

title: Avoid in weekends
text: Pretending to be upper class, rates are, but overall lack of quality. Location is great, breakfast buffet ok. Why not clean and redress empty tablets? Staff leaves everything unattended. Fridaynight next to pool outside wedding party with loud music till past midnight, saturday same loud music inside for one more wedding. This in a hotel that is structurally under-isolated acoustically. Food quality in restaurant seems unsure, Reading other comments. I was refused a windowside table in a nearly empty restaurant. Poolside you can wait for an hour for a waiter, bringing what you did not order. Certainly there are beter places around!

title: Wearing a uniform and having a badge does not mean that you are good!
text:
On the face of it this hotel has everything going for it. Good rooms, good food and a good location. At least it had a good location but all day the diggers are at it moving boulder sized rocks around so that the infinity pool grinds to a halt with a view of a pile of rocks rather than the ocean. Not the hotels fault but unfortunate for the guests. Also there are some fairly ripe smells drifting into the pool area. What the hotel could control was the setting up for the New Year Party during the afternoon of heavyweight gantries for lighting. Two days before NYE. So the guests got the boulder moving followed by the banging and crashing of the gantry team all day!  The pool was not a place for contemplation.
However on arrival we expected the room that we had ordered. "Stunning views of the green and the ocean" This is printed on the booking form. The first room had a great view of a dual carriageway, the second room offered had stunning views of a car park! I asked for the duty manager, who initially was unreceptive.....I pressed firmly and we got a small upgrade. But I should not have needed to!
Also on entry we explained to the front desk that we had a night flight and exiting our room at 12.00 p.m. was going to leave us with 12 hours of hanging around. What could they do to help?

The answer was to shrug their shoulders. We worked out that there was a spa, we could sit poolside (with our noise cancelling earphones), eat from the poolside cafe and bathe before leaving for the airport. We worked this out, but the solution was not offered by the hotel staff.

I was thinking that in this day and age, a hotel needs to offer really good customer service and expect to be rated highly in Tripadvisor and on other websites. The attitude of the staff (comes from the top) appears to be how do we get the client to part with their money. 

So the staff have the uniform and the badge. What they don't have is the guest care culture nor I suspect have many of them seen service at a really good hotel.  Shame

title: Just OK
text:
Seems a nice hotel at check-in, and looks great online.   Fact is that the rooms are average, not very big at all. Two lifts for the size of this hotel means a waiting ages sometimes.  Pool is ok but not enough deck chairs for the number of guests.   Limited space 

Service is just ok, nothing great.   At check-in we requested a room with a view and were given one over the pool, great. What the clerk neglected to tell us was,  that night there was a pool party with disco until midnight.  

Asked for taxi to a local restaurant and they gave us a hotel car.  When we asked the driver, Edward, 'how much' (there was no meter), he replied "3", I asked 300 Sri Lanka Rupees, he chuckled, and I had to then insist to get a price from a hotel driver!?   I had he stop the car and out we got.  

The next morning I recounted both situations to the duty manager and she said she would look into it.  When we arrived pack to the hotel there was a bottle of wine in the room with no note or message.  I assume it is an apology, but perhaps will be added to the bill??  Great lack of communication.   

Will not ever stay here again.   There are many other quality hotels close by and more opening soon.

title: It’s a nice hotel to stay if the guest receives a better service.
text: We had our wedding on December  @ this hotel. The location is very nice. Food was great. But the service is very poor for a 5 star hotel. One steward accidentally split a welcome drink on one of my guest ruined her saree. The staff didn't even apologized. Even we had to carry our luggage from changing room to our other room.

title: Very Small Rooms - Crowded Hotel
text: We stayed with our family of 2 adults, 1 child and 1 infant for one night & day. The rooms are very small and hardly has any space to move around. The hotel is very crowded because it is located in the heart of Colombo and the hotel accomodates many other activities. Like on the date of our check in there was a wedding in one of their halls and the hotel was jam packed and it was a complete chaos at the lobby. In fact we were checked in and given our access cards to one of the rooms and when we opened the room we happened to find some other guests in the room. It was later found that the room was not vacant and it was allotted to us by mistake. Imaging someone walking into our room hoping. We were quite embarrassed putting ourself in that situation. The only good thing abt the hotel is that the food rates are quite reasonable but that is compensated by low quantity of food. We ordered fried rice which was priced low but the quantity was very low that we had to re order two additional fried rice. Swimming pool is good and well maintained. Overall a very big hotel with small rooms, poor service and crowded place.

title: Room Facilities are good.
text: Guest room that I stayed and facilities,services provided by the Room services staff was Great.Comfortable bed and nice shower room. No long bath in my room. Excellent water pressure and good air condition in room. Room is very clean and with very big window to enjoy the beauty of sea

title: Good location, service might need a boost
text:
Difficult to rate this hotel as it was my first trip to Colombo. If I compare this to other 5* properties in Asian capitals it's under par but compared to the rest of Colombo its surprisingly good (I've been told..) 
I'll give a quick overview of + and -

+
Location close to everything
Overall grandeur
Car service; 4 hours + driver who waits while shopping for around $20
Plenty F&B options
Facilities like pool and spa
Safe haven in busy Colombo

-
Cleanliness of the room; used toothbrush still in bathroom plus full garbage bin
Breakfast service: Instead of a 'hello' we got told what time the buffet closes
Speed of service in F&B outlets; takes long to get a drink, especially when considering the amount of staff
Staff is not unfriendly but also not overly hospitable. I don't need to talk to everyone, but a casual greeting with eye-contact would be great. 

Overall not a bad experience but I expected more from a hotel with this pedigree

title: Lousy service
text:
Be very careful not to leave anything behind at this hotel. We telephoned once, emailed twice and sent a fax  over the last 6 weeks, about some pyjamas left under a pillow. Not a word.
The hotel is glitzy and busy. Breakfast disappointing for a five star hotel.

title: Great location,yet a bit noisy during day and night
text: Hotel is beautifully located with refurnished interior, apart from Gymnasium.If you are looking for a quiet place to rest, think twice,since my arrival 3 days ago every night there are functions in the hotel and the noise makes it difficult to rest.Swimming pool is not really relaxing as there is construction being held on both sides and the decibel level reaches 90, which is above a safety norm. Pool offers poor privacy, as not only hotel and restaurant rooms are overlooking it but also passing cars and pedestrians on the road.I am disappointed as had high expectations of this place.

title: Not worth
text: No housekeeping in the.night time. Have to call front office for night service regarding house keepin. Very slow room service. Lack in variety of.food. The room on 8 th floor.is.good..very pricey..staff is polite but inexperienced. I would not.recommend.unless they come down on the.price and the quality of service and food

title: Very Bad Hospitality
text:
Very Terrible Service
Property is well built and location is excellent.
Customer Service is really bad.
None of the Staff are of helping attitude.
For every service, i had to call 4-5 times.
Very bad Hospitality.
Being a 5 Star property, nobody is there to welcome you while you check-in.
They promise one thing when you book and deliver a different when you check-in.

title: NOT AT ALL THE MONEY WORTH IT...ONLY SHINY,NO QUALITY BEHIND
text:
...marbel,glas,managers in black suits with ties....but thats it...
if it comes to food,to service this place fails definetly.
cheap unexperienced waiters,who dont even know to give a napkin when it comes to lnch,dinner or snack..
managers unabel to solve complains..
more a place for locals who want to appear important or dont know quality...
dissapointing service and food which is not at all the money and high prices worth it.

title: Nice place but beware of some rooms
text: We had booked 2 rooms at Kingsbury and the reception gave us Room 214 and 216.  The moment we entered 214 the full room was stinking of urine.  Then we went to 216 and that room as a smoke factory - stinking of smoke.  I then called the person incharge on that floor and bought this to his notice to which he replied that the hotel was fully booked and we cannot change the room. Someone told me that both these rooms have a problem generally.  I then told them we had paid good money for it and we were definitely not going to live in a room stinking of urine.  Then they took sometime and came back and told us we can take 209 but with no view.  I was really upset.  I then walked down to the reception and there was this really nice Indian guy and i explained the whole scenario to him.  He was very courteous and told me that he would upgrade us to 2 rooms on the Executive Floor.  Finally after 2 long hours we were upgraded to 925 and 927.  These rooms were lovely and it had a good view.

title: All night party
text: The Hotel is fine but it is Sunday Night and, even though I phoned the front desk, there is a large private function going on with loud blaring music throughout the 8th floor.  I have spoken to the duty manager who said it would end at 11:30 pm but it is still going on now.  I do not recommend a hotel that allows its guests to be so disturbed on a Sunday evening.

title: Everything is ok but noise-free
text:
I stayed at Kingsbury for one week for a training in September. 
Room: Hotel is new, room is new, bed is very good, bath room is a bit small though. Room with white colour is nice. However the noise-free is really a big issue! It seems the wall and/or the door is too thin for noise-free. When someone rang the doorbell of the opposite room, it sound like ringing my own room 's doorbell; and the worse came in one night where I heard clear strong music from somewhere (that I tried but could not defined) during more than 2 hours, although my room was at 7th floor. My colleagues have the same complaint about this noise-free issue of the hotel. 
View: view to the sea and habour, swimming pool (depending on which side you are) is wonderful. 
Foods: The hotel has 3 restaurants as far as I may know: the biggest one for buffet, a chinese restaurant and one for sea food. My colleagues and I had all breakfast and lunch at the hotel, we tried all these 3 restaurants, and the foods were abundant and quite delicious. 
Location: Good location. Just some steps from the hotel is "Dutch hospital" - an area of well-known restaurants, especially "Ministry of Crab".
Fitness, Spa and swimming pool: Good. Outside infinity swimming pool is really nice place for sunset viewing. For spa, they have steam sauna, heat cabin and jacuzzi.
Staff: Quite fast and diligent. Remember to turn on the "Don't disturb", or they will ring your doorbell on a frequent basis just to ask whether you are ok with the room service.
A tip:  you may need to check the hotel bill carefully, one of my colleague got charged for the minibar while she did not touch it, and I myself got an unusual high room rate as they recorded wrongly that my room was double occupancy.

title: High Tea -The Kingsbury
text:
Bit Disappointed with the Kingsbury High Tea. 

Morning Coffee Shop transformed into High Tea seating area doesn't seems to be the best for a Five Star hotel. 

The Food spread is rather limited, the savory selection was very small, preferred if the management could include some local savories like patties, mini fish rottie, stuffed chillies and club sandwiches etc. and the sweet selection need a upgrade. the Carrot cake was too dry for my liking.    

Loved the ice tea, the ice coffee was quite nice. 

Overall, the service was quite efficient and the staff was polite. 

Wish the  management find a more appropriate location, and consider improving the selection.

title: High Tea
text:
I found it average. Less choice of food. They had ice cream , not the best of taste.
You might want to review the choice of food going forward. There was a lady playing the piano. Good idea to have a jazz player. I prefer the Galle Face high tea.

title: Not as good as we'd hoped given the price
text:
An average hotel, quite expensive for what it is.  They did honour request of a ocean view room and were polite enough.  The breakfast was not worth the price and lacked any sort of enthusiastic service (apart from napkin fluffing constantly and watching you eat).  It appears there was a severe lack of cooked breakfast options.

We were disappointed to just be handed cans of beer in the Sky Bar given that they were three times the price of anywhere else we'd had a beer the whole trip - you think they would at least pour it for us?

The room was good - lovely bathroom, comfortable bed.  Agreed with previous comments about the stale cigarette smell in hallways.  And the cleaners really should wait for a response after knocking before entering the room at 8am in the morning.

You can arrange a "budget taxi" for airport transfer at 2500LKR which was more than suitable as long as you're prepared to be looked at like you shouldn't be staying here - I think they'd rather you pay more than double.

Overall, there was a sombre mood to the place and we've stayed in better places for half the price.

title: Excellent view washed away by extremely bad service
text:
I stayed at The Kingsbury for a office event for 7 days. 
First the good things - the hotel is new, has a very good view - its right next to the sea, the rooms are nice and offer a sea view

Now the real pain - the hotel service staff is clearly not even trained to be at a guest house. This incident which happened with 4 of my colleagues - a guy came to clean the rooms in the morning at 8.30 am. I told him please come later as I had to get ready - he thinks for a while - says can he please clean it now as he needs to go home at 4 pm. Next in the evening in the pool - we were 5 of us in the pool which was scheduled to close at 9 pm. The pool guy comes to  us at 8.30 pm, asks us if we can vacate the pool a bit early as he needs to catch his transport at 9 and because of this he want to leave early. The food menu was a bigger disaster, where in the breakfast you need to stand in line to get your dosa or omelette as the waiter does not bring it to your table. Their Asian restaurant was a even bigger dud when it came to the quality of food - super oily prawns, bad lobster. Even the internet service is bad, so could not get much work done. All in all, never going there again.

title: Lovely location but very inexperienced staff
text:
Perfect located newly refurbished hotel just by the shore of the Indian Ocean.
Room with an extraordinary view and super comfortable bed.
Check in very fast, charming and sufficient but rest of the staff working in the hotel seem to be very inexperienced with hospitality work.
Especially in the food and beverage sector.
Had both lunch and dinner at the hotel during my stay and was amazed how low the knowledge was from restaurant staff about food and drinks they served.
To keep up I really think the hotel management have to train there staff in those fields.
Unfortunately, it's not enough with a nice view to stay alive star hotel.

title: High Tea @ The Kingsbury
text:
First Impression : Not the best "High Tea" in Colombo

The "High Tea" area is situated close to the pool exit near the coffee shop. It feels like the hotel had some extra space in the lobby and decided to put up a "High Tea" menu there. I was not at all happy with the setting, the only reason they seem to have this menu is because all the other hotels in Colombo have "High Tea".

The food spread was very poor and given the price you can have a much better "High Tea" experience in any other Colombo hotel. The sandwich station was utterly pointless few patrons even went there. The tea station is a nice touch but they need to work on the quality of the teas served. The selection of food(savory) was very small and contained mostly fried items. The dessert(sweet) items were equally bad and had a chocolate fountain with strange dippings. Management seriously needs to work on their "High Tea" menu items.  

The service was virtually non existent and having "High Tea" at the coffee shop is a bad idea. 

Not recommended.

title: Fairly good but work to do before the Shangri-la opens
text: Polite and helpful staff. Great location....but no room service menu in room, modest mini bar and average bar downstairs equates to 3.5 stars, not 4. I am sure with work it can improve from being clearly a business hotel to a holiday one as well.

title: Some good points, some bad
text:
I haven't stayed here but I have eaten here and been to their sky bar now three times and wanted to review my experiences, which varied hugely. My first visit was to the lunch buffet, this was absolutely fabulous. The food selection was immense and all tasty. Service was ok. Out of the buffets I have had in Sri Lanka, this one was right up there with the best. The second visit was to the bakery where I had to stand for about 5 minutes while the three staff there ignored me instead of taking my order. Not great. The food itself I thought was decent and good value for money.

My next visit was to the bar. The initial service was good and attentive with the manager around. The ambiance of this bar is pretty good though you probably have to sit towards the edge of the bar to appreciate the sense of vertigo of looking out onto the ocean. What did disappoint was the waiter asserting that we had arrived before happy hour so refusing to honor  the happy hour deal. This was despite the fact we had spoken to the manager before happy hour had ended. A few stern words and the issue was solved.

The final and very disappointing experience was the mussel promo at the seafood restaurant. The preparation was mediocre and the mussels were very tough, indicating they had been cooked far too long. I've had home cooked mussels that were much better!

All in all, there is good potential but lots to improve with service especially.

title: Can't Tell a Book by its Cover
text: We booked this new hotel in Sri Lanka for a 3 night stay. After a 2.5 hour wild trip from the airport (that's a mere 25 miles) we arrived at this impressive looking hotel located right along the beautiful coastline.  Two beds were requested and confirmed prior to arrival but we were told no 2 bed rooms were available upon check-in. When we contested, we were assured a room with 2 beds would be made ready.  We ended up with a small room with a king bed and a twin bed rolled in. The bathroom accoutrements were nice (Bulgari) and the room was comfortable and clean.  However, housekeeping arrived late (5:30pm) forgot to replenish supplies like coffee and bathroom things. Each day we ordered from room service a large pot of coffee with two cups and each day we got a small pot of coffee.  There was no room service menu in the room or a book on introducing the hotel and its amenities.  When we asked for either one, the hotel manager promised they would be delivered "Immediately".  Twenty minutes later a book on Sri Lanka arrived - no room service menu or welcome pamphlet on the hotel so we never knew what restaurants or services the hotel offered. We spent an hour one evening listening to music in the Kings Lounge where we decided to take advantage of the advertised 20% discount for "ladies" on drinks and food in the bar lounge.  The discount is good if you use an HSBC card. I used my HSBC card.  The waiter brought the bill and forgot the discount.  When I pointed it out, he condescendingly told me that I needed to use an HSBC card, and when I pointed out I did, he apologized and went to adjust the bill.  This took 25 minutes, arguing at the cashier station amoung the staff, my HSBC card being charged twice and credited twice. End of the story: the manager says "our system cannot adjust your bill, you have a 750 rupee credit, would you like another drink?. By that time, we left.  I complained to the manager of the hotel, who promised to remedy the situation immediately and never did.  The beautiful buffet restaurant with gorgeous views of the ocean had a fabulous array of every kind of food you could desire in this part of the world, only the food temps were not hot.  Also, when you did find a waiter to provide coffee, every time we'd have to tell him to fill the cup. For some reason, the waiters fill coffee cups half way up - frustrating since once they pour the coffee, they disappear.  And, like the food, the coffee was never hot.  This new hotel has MANY kinks to work out and I cannot recommend it to any traveler.  Try the Hilton just down the road.

title: Wedding reception
text:
A potentially fantastic hotel that banks on its reputation. It talks the talk but unfortunately doesn't walk the walk in some aspects.

Reception are just about able to book you in. - Hadn't planned to stay here originally but having been let down elsewhere, decided to check in since the wedding that I was attending was here. Great room, location, facilities. all you would expect from a hotel of this reputation.

The morning after the wedding saw many of the wedding guests suffering with upset stomachs - to be polite! 
It is poor management to be told that there was a virus going around. = Strange how this bioselective virus chose guests at the wedding!

Won't be going back there!

title: Disappointing service
text:
My first experience of The Kingsbury, a very pleasant hotel on the surface let down by extremely poor service in specific areas. 

On the plus side:

(i) Good location overlooking sea, 
(ii) Good gym and spa facilities 
(iii) Clean, pleasant rooms. 

On the not so good:

(i) Unfriendly welcome on arrival, albeit relatively late at night 
(ii) Extremely slow service at breakfast (20 minutes for a cup of tea) 
(iii) Concerns over hygiene (human hair in buffet food) 
(iv) Excessive noise after midnight from the bar so avoid rooms on higher floors
(v) Ongoing doorbell attention, from 830am onwards

I would recommend the Cinnamon Grand for any first time visitor. Normal service and excellent restaurants, and while no sea view, and excellent pool.

title: Five star hotel with two star service👎
text: This hotel is perfect n good location n the room n pool are gorgeous, but the service are terrible especially the reception in the front desk, while i want to check out,they're eaten grape while spoken to me n spit out the seed of grape in front of me n keep talked, it was my first time in my life so far I traveled around n the reception are being so rude n lack of education or trained(he's old enough actualy). About the restorant the buffe is untasty, but the seafood restorant are nice n very good service n quick response,n sky lounge is normal.😉

title: High tea
text: This is my first visit to this hotel travelling from overseas I was so looking forward to it but was highly disappointed in the range of food it was just not tasty I was just confused the chocolate fountain looked fab but the selection of dipping items were strange... To be seated as I had come early with an infant I was just standing there with no assistance... I was also appalled considering this is a refurbished hotel there was no changing room for baby or even a bench /table which is expected in this kind of environment ! I had asked staff who had no clue. Towards 5.30pm a really scruffy looking man walked upto each guest table and changed the flower arrangement it was not the sort of person you expect in a hotel of this caliber he was not in uniform or dressed appropriately and I noted all the guest looked uncomfortable... On the positive the hotel looked stunning busy but was nice to sit around at and the ice coffee was really good:) but I would not go again..

title: Horrible food..very dissapointing..!
text: I went in to the Harbour Court in June for the first time, to grab a quick bite to eat for lunch. As I was after something light and quick I ordered the crispy calamari/squid salad. It was far from quick (the restaurant wasn't even full as it was a week day). It took them 50 minutes to bring my salad. I was expecting the best salad ever, since it took 50 minutes..it was the most horrible salad I had ever eaten. I got the smallest portion ever (perfect size for an appetizer) discoloured iceberg lettuce and squid that was not crispy AT ALL! The squid was so rubbery, the salad lacked flavour (was like eating over cooked squid mixed in sweet chili sauce) I was extremely disappointed with the portion size as well. My food did not match the menu description. Will not be going there again! Management should seriously get some good "Standard recipes" and make sure the food is consistent when it leaves the kitchen.

title: don't waste your time and money there!
text:
The Kingsbury is indeed sparkling new but perhaps too new for its own good. The service is terrible, starting with the check in desk - too my friend and I 30 minutes to check in whereas compared to the Cinnamon Grand, they make you sit and come to you to check you in!

Then we were checked in a small but nice room to find the safe not working (it was brand new yes, but useless because not working), the Wifi was not working either and they had put 1 strawberry, 2 grapes and 2 small apples as a welcome fruit basket - no word of a lie! with 1 fork. The room was obviously not ready to welcome 2 people but 1 as there was only 1 item of everything so basically, we had to share 1 bathrobe, 1 toothbrush, 1 pair of slippers and 1 body lotion between the 2 of us.
I called reception for the Wifi, housekeeping for the safe and to be provided with extra items to be told that someone would be straight up within 2 minutes - surprise surprise, nobody ever showed up.
I then called back to speak to the manager who again, told me he would be there in 2 minutes - 20 minutes later, still no one so I had to call back. The manager thinking his time was too valuable for me and my friend, decided to send another manager to try and sort everything out, by then, I had already spent 1 hour in my room just trying to sort all this mess out -- this is a 5* we are talking about here.
However, the manager who turned up listened to us and nicely enough, gave us another room on the 9th floor, the supposedly Executive floor where we could avail breakfast in the executive lounge and a round the clock dedicated buttler service.
After checking that everything was in order, we settled down.  Since we only had 1 beer in the mini bar, we call housekeeping - our dedicated butler service - to bring us some but guess what? someone turned up only ages later.
No, that's not the end of it - Since we had to catch an early flight in the morning, we were told that breakfast would be ready from 06h30 am and were looking for a nice continental breakfast  before leaving at 07h00 am.
To our surprise, indeed, breakfast was nowhere ready at 06h30 supposedly because someone had forgotten the pastries downstairs so we were politely told "sorry for the inconvenience" for the 10th time since we had arrived and told to go have breakfast on the 1st floor -- so basically, keep your extra cash you wanted to spend on the upgrade - not worth it (and the rooms are exactly the same as the other rooms!).
Check out was as similarly disastrous but not worth mentioning! 
I would honestly recommend the Cinnamon GRAND 1 or 2 blocks away!!

The only good think I can say about the Kingsbury is its nice location next to the Old Dutch Hospital where you can have a good meal and a few drinks.

title: Coping with war & now peace.
text:
I have a special corner in my heart for this hotel. In 1976/13/10; I got married here and spent the first night of a memorable honeymoon. Since then till 10 years ago I spent 50% of my time
overseas staying exclusively in 4 and 5 star properties. The 30 year war robed us of our hospitality elite. We Sri Lankans are born with smiles on our faces & warm hearts. Hotels here were fortunate if they had 5% occupancy & 10% patronage in the restaurants. The result is that those with 10 to 30yrs experience are used to small numbers. Gone are the days hotels had 5 to 10 customers walking in per day. Now the staff have to cope with the same number every 5 to 10 minutes. The senior staff in most 5 star hotels cannot cope with the rush. The acolytes are trying to take- on too much. On the 4th of April I watched in dismay how 7 to 8 staff took an hour to serve a group of 90 Sampath Bank share holders( the other 110 left earlier unwilling to waste time) a cup of tea or coffee. I sat in the lobby for a hot cup of green tea which was promptly and politely served. The pot (enough for 3) had been filled with about 15 teaspoons (75% of the pot) of green tea just for me. The first cup was good. The second cup had too much tannin similar to a badly made left bank Cab/Sauv of a poor vintage. 
The service staff were disorganized & lacked anticipation due to the lack of experience. They were polite. The solution to this is closer supervision by the supervisors and managers. Hotels in Sri Lanka are notorious for executives and managers who spend an average of 3 to 4 hours of a day at 'meetings'. This was the way they killed time during the war years.

title: Club noise heard in suite, rowdy restaurants, poor service
text:
My wife booked this hotel as a surprise for our wedding anniversary, she had pre-arranged for them to put rose petals on the bed-fruit basket etc.

Though when checking in, they hadn't done anything, it took over an hour for them to fetch a fruit basket consisting of one apple and one orange and no basket. Rose petals didn't come despise numerous complaints to hotel staff. Eventually my wife gave up. Resulting in her being very upset and angry, which after booking a suite should not be the case.

My wife booked the suite to give us exclusive access to the private executive lounge, which we were unable to use, as was full of a large gathering of rowdy drunken men and my wife was very intimidated so couldn't go in and enjoy it.

We went for dinner at their Chinese restaurant after making a reservation for our wedding anniversary. We were given a table next to a large gathering of local men again, which after we had ordered food, we're very noisy and loud I was unable to have an intimate conversation with my wife. I waited to see if any of the staff asked them to lower the amount of noise, but they didn't so I asked the waiter to go and ask them. They did go quite for like 5 mins but then none of the staff asked them again.

We wanted to sit in the lobby bar and have a quite Romantic drink and a bottle of champagne, but there was a private function going on for outsiders and they had a very loud music playing again, when anyone would expect soft ambiance music in the lobby.

When we went back to the room and night time only then had the petals been put, which was too late. 

We had been up since early hours in the morning and were extreamly tired so were so tired, yet the amount of noise from the sky lounge club on
The rooftop could clearly be hered in the suite, I waited patiently till midnight then I called to complain and was told they would lower it but it didnt happen. I asked what time they close I was told 1am but gone 1am and music was still banging trough room.

Don't get me wrong Iove music but there is a time and a place for it and I don't think a 5 star hotel should give me the same feeling as clubbing in Ibiza or malia.

When you book any hotel, you expect to have a room at least where you can relax and sleep at least but I couldn't sleep in this room an dont feel refreshed after a night here.

There are better managed hotel in Sri Lanka, where they prioritise them self on being a hotel rather than a club or function hall and taken great care to reduce noise levels for the guests. Like before I stayed at cinnamon grand and the noise in the atrium from private functions had to finish by 1030! So I think its extreamly wrong for the sky Louge to be open so late if the music is disturbing guests in their rooms.

title: Pathetic service and chaos at the roof top pub.
text:
I visited the newly opened Kingsbury Hotel roof top pub. It should be noted that the location is breathtaking and t here are no other similar places in Colombo. It is a unique place overlooking the ocean on one side and the city on the other side. 
However I was surprised to see the disorganized, non professional, chaotic way the show was run by the pub staff. Nobody had an idea what they are supposed to do. The cashier at the bar was totally baffled and confused. He made mistakes over and over again. On top of everything we had to wait more than one hour, believe me I m not exaggerating, to get the drinks we ordered. Before the drinks were served the utterly confused waiter brought the finger food which was obviously finished by the time the drinks came. We had to request more than five times from the waiters, supervisors, bar men and the cashier to serve our orders. It was very obvious that the bar man or the waiters were not trained at all to work in a set up like that. They were so disorganized and unprofessional. They did not know how to make the cocktails that are listed in the drinks menu even. Finally they served some drinks except the cocktails we ordered and the cocktails were served only when it was about to close the pub. It was simply a pathetic situation.
There was plenty staff but none of them even did not know to be polite and at least to say sorry for the inconvenience caused to the guest by their own faults. I have seen a compile of groups leaving the place due to their frustration by even shouting at the staff. 
It is a shame that the best pub, ( I would unreservedly call it) as far as the location is concerned, is not functioning at least up to the standard of a tavern on the street. I hope at least the management would see this comment and take steps to run this place in such a way so that the  guests to enjoy the unique ambience this place has.
